sanskrit_devanagari: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः। मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय।।
transliteration_iast: dhṛitarāśhtra uvācha dharma-kṣhetre kuru-kṣhetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāśhchaiva kimakurvata sañjaya
english_translation: The King Dhritarashtra asked, "O Sanjaya! What happened on the sacred battlefield of Kurukshetra when my people and the Pandavas gathered?"
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सञ्जय उवाच दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा। आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्।।
transliteration_iast: sañjaya uvācha dṛiṣhṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṁ vyūḍhaṁ duryodhanastadā āchāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vachanamabravīt
english_translation: Sanjaya replied: "When Prince Duryodhana saw the Pandavas' army paraded, he approached his preceptor Guru Drona and spoke these words:
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम्। व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता।।
transliteration_iast: paśhyaitāṁ pāṇḍu-putrāṇām āchārya mahatīṁ chamūm vyūḍhāṁ drupada-putreṇa tava śhiṣhyeṇa dhīmatā
english_translation: Revered Father! Behold this mighty host of the Pandavas, paraded by the son of King Drupada, your wise disciple.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि। युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः।।
transliteration_iast: atra śhūrā maheṣhvāsā bhīmārjuna-samā yudhi yuyudhāno virāṭaśhcha drupadaśhcha mahā-rathaḥ
english_translation: In it are heroes and great bowmen; the equals in battle of Arjuna, Bheema, Yuyudhana, Virata, and Drupada—all great soldiers.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान्। पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः।।
transliteration_iast: dhṛiṣhṭaketuśhchekitānaḥ kāśhirājaśhcha vīryavān purujit kuntibhojaśhcha śhaibyaśhcha nara-puṅgavaḥ yudhāmanyuśhcha vikrānta uttamaujāśhcha vīryavān
english_translation: Dhrishtaketu, Chekitan, the valiant king of Benares, Purujit, Kuntibhoja, and Shaibya—a master of many.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान्। सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः।।
transliteration_iast: saubhadro draupadeyāśhcha sarva eva mahā-rathāḥ
english_translation: Yudhamanyu, Uttamouja, Soubhadra, and the sons of Droupadi—all famous men.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम। नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते।।
transliteration_iast: asmākaṁ tu viśhiṣhṭā ye tānnibodha dwijottama nāyakā mama sainyasya sanjñārthaṁ tānbravīmi te
english_translation: No changes needed.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः। अश्वत्थात्मा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च।।
transliteration_iast: bhavānbhīṣhmaśhcha karṇaśhcha kṛipaśhcha samitiñjayaḥ aśhvatthāmā vikarṇaśhcha saumadattis tathaiva cha
english_translation: You come first; then Bheeshma, Karna, Kripa, great warriors; Ashwaththama, Vikarna, and the son of Somadhatta;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः। नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः।।
transliteration_iast: anye cha bahavaḥ śhūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ nānā-śhastra-praharaṇāḥ sarve yuddha-viśhāradāḥ
english_translation: And many others, all ready to die for My sake; all armed, all skilled in warfare.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम्। पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम्।।
transliteration_iast: aparyāptaṁ tadasmākaṁ balaṁ bhīṣhmābhirakṣhitam paryāptaṁ tvidameteṣhāṁ balaṁ bhīmābhirakṣhitam
english_translation: Yet our army seems weaker, though commanded by Bhishma; their army seems stronger, though commanded by Bhima.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः। भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि।।
transliteration_iast: ayaneṣhu cha sarveṣhu yathā-bhāgamavasthitāḥ bhīṣhmamevābhirakṣhantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi
english_translation: Therefore, let the rank and file stand firm in their posts according to battalions, and all you generals around Bheeshma.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्य संजनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः। सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान्।।
transliteration_iast: tasya sañjanayan harṣhaṁ kuru-vṛiddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ siṁha-nādaṁ vinadyochchaiḥ śhaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān
english_translation: Then, to enliven his spirits, the brave Grandfather Bheeshma, the eldest of the Kuru clan, blew his conch, its sound resembling that of a lion's roar.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः। सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्।।
transliteration_iast: tataḥ śhaṅkhāśhcha bheryaśhcha paṇavānaka-gomukhāḥ sahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śhabdastumulo ’bhavat
english_translation: And immediately, all the conches, drums, trumpets, and horns blared forth in a tumultuous uproar.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ। माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः।।
transliteration_iast: tataḥ śhvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau mādhavaḥ pāṇḍavaśhchaiva divyau śhaṅkhau pradadhmatuḥ
english_translation: Then, seated in their spacious war chariot, yoked with white horses, Lord Shri Krishna and Arjuna sounded their divine conch shells.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः। पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः।।
transliteration_iast: pāñchajanyaṁ hṛiṣhīkeśho devadattaṁ dhanañjayaḥ pauṇḍraṁ dadhmau mahā-śhaṅkhaṁ bhīma-karmā vṛikodaraḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna blew his Panchajanya, and Arjuna blew his Devadatta; brave Bheema blew his renowned shell, Poundra.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ।।
transliteration_iast: anantavijayaṁ rājā kuntī-putro yudhiṣhṭhiraḥ nakulaḥ sahadevaśhcha sughoṣha-maṇipuṣhpakau
english_translation: The King Dharmaraja, the son of Kunti, blew the Anantavijaya, Nakula, and Sahadeva, the Sughosa and Manipushpaka, respectively.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः। धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः।।
transliteration_iast: kāśhyaśhcha parameṣhvāsaḥ śhikhaṇḍī cha mahā-rathaḥ dhṛiṣhṭadyumno virāṭaśhcha sātyakiśh chāparājitaḥ
english_translation: And the Maharaja of Benares, the great archer, Shikhandi, the great soldier, Dhrishtayumna, Virata, and Satyaki, the invincible one,
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते। सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक्।।
transliteration_iast: drupado draupadeyāśhcha sarvaśhaḥ pṛithivī-pate saubhadraśhcha mahā-bāhuḥ śhaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛithak pṛithak
english_translation: And, O King! Drupada's sons, Droupadi's sons, and the great soldier Soubhadra blew their conches.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत्। नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलो व्यनुनादयन्।।
transliteration_iast: sa ghoṣho dhārtarāṣhṭrāṇāṁ hṛidayāni vyadārayat nabhaśhcha pṛithivīṁ chaiva tumulo nunādayan
english_translation: The tumult rent the hearts of the sons of Dhritarashtra, shaking heaven and earth with its echoing violence.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अथ व्यवस्थितान् दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान्कपिध्वजः। प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसंपाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः।।
transliteration_iast: atha vyavasthitān dṛiṣhṭvā dhārtarāṣhṭrān kapi-dhwajaḥ pravṛitte śhastra-sampāte dhanurudyamya pāṇḍavaḥ hṛiṣhīkeśhaṁ tadā vākyam idam āha mahī-pate
english_translation: Then, upon beholding the sons of Dhritarashtra, drawn up on the battlefield, ready to fight, Arjuna, whose flag bore the image of Hanuman,
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते। सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha senayor ubhayor madhye rathaṁ sthāpaya me ’chyuta
english_translation: Raising his bow, he spoke this to the Lord Shri Krishna: O Infallible Lord of the earth! Please draw up my chariot between the two armies.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान्। कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन्रणसमुद्यमे।।
transliteration_iast: yāvadetān nirīkṣhe ’haṁ yoddhu-kāmān avasthitān kairmayā saha yoddhavyam asmin raṇa-samudyame
english_translation: So that I may observe those who must fight on my side and those who must fight against me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः।।
transliteration_iast: yotsyamānān avekṣhe ’haṁ ya ete ’tra samāgatāḥ dhārtarāṣhṭrasya durbuddher yuddhe priya-chikīrṣhavaḥ
english_translation: And gaze upon this array of soldiers, eager to please the sons of Dhritarashtra who are sinful.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सञ्जय उवाच एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत। सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम्।।
transliteration_iast: sañjaya uvācha evam ukto hṛiṣhīkeśho guḍākeśhena bhārata senayor ubhayor madhye sthāpayitvā rathottamam
english_translation: Sanjaya said: "Having listened to Arjuna's request, Lord Shri Krishna drew up His bright chariot in the midst between the two armies.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम्। उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति।।
transliteration_iast: bhīṣhma-droṇa-pramukhataḥ sarveṣhāṁ cha mahī-kṣhitām uvācha pārtha paśhyaitān samavetān kurūn iti
english_translation: Where Bheeshma and Drona had led all the rulers of the earth, they spoke thus: O Arjuna! Behold, these members of the family of Kuru are assembled.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितृ़नथ पितामहान्। आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातृ़न्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा।।
transliteration_iast: tatrāpaśhyat sthitān pārthaḥ pitṝīn atha pitāmahān āchāryān mātulān bhrātṝīn putrān pautrān sakhīṁs tathā śhvaśhurān suhṛidaśh chaiva senayor ubhayor api
english_translation: There, Arjuna noticed fathers, grandfathers, uncles, cousins, sons, grandsons, teachers, and friends.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि। तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान्।।
transliteration_iast: tān samīkṣhya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvān bandhūn avasthitān kṛipayā parayāviṣhṭo viṣhīdann idam abravīt
english_translation: Fathers-in-law and benefactors were arrayed on both sides, and Arjuna then gazed at all those kinsmen before him.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत्। दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम्।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha dṛiṣhṭvemaṁ sva-janaṁ kṛiṣhṇa yuyutsuṁ samupasthitam
english_translation: And his heart melted with pity, and sadly he spoke: "O my Lord! When I see all these, my own people, thirsting for battle,
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति। वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते।।
transliteration_iast: sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṁ cha pariśhuṣhyati vepathuśh cha śharīre me roma-harṣhaśh cha jāyate
english_translation: My limbs are failing me, my throat is parched, my body is trembling, and my hair is standing on end.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते। न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः।।
transliteration_iast: gāṇḍīvaṁ sraṁsate hastāt tvak chaiva paridahyate na cha śhaknomy avasthātuṁ bhramatīva cha me manaḥ
english_translation: The bow Gandiva slips from my hand, and my skin burns. I cannot remain still, for my mind is in tumult.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव। न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे।।
transliteration_iast: nimittāni cha paśhyāmi viparītāni keśhava na cha śhreyo ’nupaśhyāmi hatvā sva-janam āhave
english_translation: The omens are unfavorable; what good can come from the slaughter of my people on this battlefield?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च। किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा।।
transliteration_iast: na kāṅkṣhe vijayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa na cha rājyaṁ sukhāni cha kiṁ no rājyena govinda kiṁ bhogair jīvitena vā
english_translation: Ah, my Lord! I do not crave victory, nor a kingdom, nor any pleasure. What would a kingdom, happiness, or life be to me?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च। त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च।।
transliteration_iast: yeṣhām arthe kāṅkṣhitaṁ no rājyaṁ bhogāḥ sukhāni cha ta ime ’vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṁs tyaktvā dhanāni cha
english_translation: When those for whose sake I desire these things stand here, about to sacrifice their property and lives:
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः। मातुलाः श्चशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा।।
transliteration_iast: āchāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrās tathaiva cha pitāmahāḥ mātulāḥ śhvaśhurāḥ pautrāḥ śhyālāḥ sambandhinas tathā
english_translation: Teachers, fathers, grandfathers, sons, grandsons, uncles, fathers-in-law, brothers-in-law, and other relatives.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन। अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते।।
transliteration_iast: etān na hantum ichchhāmi ghnato ’pi madhusūdana api trailokya-rājyasya hetoḥ kiṁ nu mahī-kṛite
english_translation: I would not kill them, even for three worlds; why then for this earth alone? It matters not if I myself am killed.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन। पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः।।
transliteration_iast: nihatya dhārtarāṣhṭrān naḥ kā prītiḥ syāj janārdana pāpam evāśhrayed asmān hatvaitān ātatāyinaḥ
english_translation: My Lord! What happiness can come from the death of these sons of Dhritarashtra? We shall be committing a sin if we kill these desperate men.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान्। स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव।।
transliteration_iast: tasmān nārhā vayaṁ hantuṁ dhārtarāṣhṭrān sa-bāndhavān sva-janaṁ hi kathaṁ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava
english_translation: We are worthy of a nobler feat than slaughtering our relatives—the sons of Dhritarashtra; for, my Lord, how can we be happy if we kill our kinsmen?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः। कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम्।।
transliteration_iast: yady apy ete na paśhyanti lobhopahata-chetasaḥ kula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ mitra-drohe cha pātakam
english_translation: Although these men, blinded by greed, see no guilt in destroying their kin or fighting against their friends,
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम्। कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन।।
transliteration_iast: kathaṁ na jñeyam asmābhiḥ pāpād asmān nivartitum kula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ prapaśhyadbhir janārdana
english_translation: Should we not, whose eyes are open and who consider it wrong to annihilate our family, turn away from such a great crime?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः। धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत।।
transliteration_iast: kula-kṣhaye praṇaśhyanti kula-dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ dharme naṣhṭe kulaṁ kṛitsnam adharmo ’bhibhavaty uta
english_translation: The destruction of our kindred means the destruction of the traditions of our ancient lineage, and when these are lost, irreligion will overrun our homes.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः। स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः।।
transliteration_iast: adharmābhibhavāt kṛiṣhṇa praduṣhyanti kula-striyaḥ strīṣhu duṣhṭāsu vārṣhṇeya jāyate varṇa-saṅkaraḥ
english_translation: When irreligion spreads, the women of the house start to stray; when they lose their purity, adulteration of the lineage follows.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च। पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः।।
transliteration_iast: saṅkaro narakāyaiva kula-ghnānāṁ kulasya cha patanti pitaro hy eṣhāṁ lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ
english_translation: Promiscuity ruins both the family and those who defile it; while the souls of our ancestors droop, due to the lack of funeral cakes and ablutions.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः। उत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः।।
transliteration_iast: doṣhair etaiḥ kula-ghnānāṁ varṇa-saṅkara-kārakaiḥ utsādyante jāti-dharmāḥ kula-dharmāśh cha śhāśhvatāḥ
english_translation: By the destruction of our lineage and the pollution of our blood, ancient class traditions and family purity alike perish.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन। नरकेऽनियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम।।
transliteration_iast: utsanna-kula-dharmāṇāṁ manuṣhyāṇāṁ janārdana narake ‘niyataṁ vāso bhavatītyanuśhuśhruma
english_translation: The wise say, my Lord, that they are forever lost whose ancient traditions have been lost.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्। यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः।।
transliteration_iast: aho bata mahat pāpaṁ kartuṁ vyavasitā vayam yad rājya-sukha-lobhena hantuṁ sva-janam udyatāḥ
english_translation: Alas, it is strange that we should be willing to kill our own countrymen and commit a great sin, in order to enjoy the pleasures of kingdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः। धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्।।
transliteration_iast: yadi mām apratīkāram aśhastraṁ śhastra-pāṇayaḥ dhārtarāṣhṭrā raṇe hanyus tan me kṣhemataraṁ bhavet
english_translation: If, on the contrary, the sons of Dhritarashtra, with weapons in hand, should slay me, unarmed and unresisting, surely that would be better for my welfare!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सञ्जय उवाच एवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः।।
transliteration_iast: sañjaya uvācha evam uktvārjunaḥ saṅkhye rathopastha upāviśhat visṛijya sa-śharaṁ chāpaṁ śhoka-saṁvigna-mānasaḥ
english_translation: Sanjaya said: "Having spoken thus, Arjuna sank into the seat of his chariot, discarding his bow and arrow, overwhelmed with grief in the midst of the armies."
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सञ्जय उवाच तं तथा कृपयाऽविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम्। विषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः।।
transliteration_iast: sañjaya uvācha taṁ tathā kṛipayāviṣhṭamaśhru pūrṇākulekṣhaṇam viṣhīdantamidaṁ vākyam uvācha madhusūdanaḥ
english_translation: Sanjaya then told how the Lord Shri Krishna, seeing Arjuna overwhelmed with compassion, his eyes dimmed with flowing tears and full of despondency, consoled him:
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम्। अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha kutastvā kaśhmalamidaṁ viṣhame samupasthitam anārya-juṣhṭamaswargyam akīrti-karam arjuna
english_translation: The Lord said: My beloved friend! Why yield to this weakness, on the eve of battle, which does no credit to those who call themselves Aryans and only brings them infamy, barring them from the gates of heaven?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते। क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप।।
transliteration_iast: klaibyaṁ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitat tvayyupapadyate kṣhudraṁ hṛidaya-daurbalyaṁ tyaktvottiṣhṭha parantapa
english_translation: O Arjuna! Why give way to unmanliness? O thou, who art the terror of thy enemies! Shake off such shameful effeminacy and make ready to act!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच कथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन। इषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजार्हावरिसूदन।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha kathaṁ bhīṣhmam ahaṁ sankhye droṇaṁ cha madhusūdana iṣhubhiḥ pratiyotsyāmi pūjārhāvari-sūdana
english_translation: Arjuna argued: My Lord! How can I, when the battle rages, send an arrow through Bheeshma and Drona, whom I should revere?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान् श्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके। हत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव भुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान्।।
transliteration_iast: gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān śhreyo bhoktuṁ bhaikṣhyamapīha loke hatvārtha-kāmāṁstu gurūnihaiva bhuñjīya bhogān rudhira-pradigdhān
english_translation: Rather, I would be content with a beggar's crust than to kill these teachers of mine, these precious noble souls! To slay these masters who are my benefactors would be to stain the sweetness of life's pleasures with their blood.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो यद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः। यानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषाम स्तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः।।
transliteration_iast: na chaitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ yāneva hatvā na jijīviṣhāmas te ’vasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣhṭrāḥ
english_translation: Nor can I say whether it would be better for them to conquer me or for me to conquer them, since I would no longer care to live if I killed these sons of Dhritarashtra, who are now preparing for battle.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसंमूढचेताः। यच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्िचतं ब्रूहि तन्मे शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम्।।
transliteration_iast: kārpaṇya-doṣhopahata-svabhāvaḥ pṛichchhāmi tvāṁ dharma-sammūḍha-chetāḥ yach-chhreyaḥ syānniśhchitaṁ brūhi tanme śhiṣhyaste ’haṁ śhādhi māṁ tvāṁ prapannam
english_translation: My heart is oppressed with pity, and my mind is confused as to what my duty is. Therefore, my Lord, tell me what is best for my spiritual welfare, for I am Your disciple. Please direct me, I pray.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न हि प्रपश्यामि ममापनुद्या द्यच्छोकमुच्छोषणमिन्द्रियाणाम्। अवाप्य भूमावसपत्नमृद्धम् राज्यं सुराणामपि चाधिपत्यम्।।
transliteration_iast: na hi prapaśhyāmi mamāpanudyād yach-chhokam uchchhoṣhaṇam-indriyāṇām avāpya bhūmāv-asapatnamṛiddhaṁ rājyaṁ surāṇāmapi chādhipatyam
english_translation: For even if I were to attain the monarchy of the visible world, or the sovereignty over the invisible world, it would not drive away the anguish that is now paralyzing my senses.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सञ्जय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं गुडाकेशः परन्तप। न योत्स्य इति गोविन्दमुक्त्वा तूष्णीं बभूव ह।।
transliteration_iast: sañjaya uvācha evam-uktvā hṛiṣhīkeśhaṁ guḍākeśhaḥ parantapa na yotsya iti govindam uktvā tūṣhṇīṁ babhūva ha
english_translation: Sanjaya continued: "Arjuna, the conqueror of all enemies, then told the Lord of All-Hearts that he would not fight, and became silent, O King!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तमुवाच हृषीकेशः प्रहसन्निव भारत। सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये विषीदन्तमिदं वचः।।
transliteration_iast: tam-uvācha hṛiṣhīkeśhaḥ prahasanniva bhārata senayorubhayor-madhye viṣhīdantam-idaṁ vachaḥ
english_translation: Thereupon, the Lord, with a gracious smile, addressed him who was so much depressed in the midst of the two armies.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच अशोच्यानन्वशोचस्त्वं प्रज्ञावादांश्च भाषसे। गतासूनगतासूंश्च नानुशोचन्ति पण्डिताः।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha aśhochyān-anvaśhochas-tvaṁ prajñā-vādānśh cha bhāṣhase gatāsūn-agatāsūnśh-cha nānuśhochanti paṇḍitāḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: Why grieve for those for whom no grief is due, yet professing wisdom? The wise grieve neither for the dead nor the living.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न त्वेवाहं जातु नासं न त्वं नेमे जनाधिपाः। न चैव न भविष्यामः सर्वे वयमतः परम्।।
transliteration_iast: na tvevāhaṁ jātu nāsaṁ na tvaṁ neme janādhipāḥ na chaiva na bhaviṣhyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param
english_translation: There was never a time when I was not, nor you, nor these princes were not; there will never be a time when we shall cease to exist.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: देहिनोऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा। तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति।।
transliteration_iast: dehino ’smin yathā dehe kaumāraṁ yauvanaṁ jarā tathā dehāntara-prāptir dhīras tatra na muhyati
english_translation: As the soul experiences infancy, youth, and old age in this body, so finally it passes into another; the wise have no delusion about this.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः। आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत।।
transliteration_iast: mātrā-sparśhās tu kaunteya śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkha-dāḥ āgamāpāyino ’nityās tans-titikṣhasva bhārata
english_translation: Those external relations that bring cold and heat, pain and happiness come and go; they are not permanent. Endure them bravely, O Prince!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्येते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ। समदुःखसुखं धीरं सोऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते।।
transliteration_iast: yaṁ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣhaṁ puruṣharṣhabha sama-duḥkha-sukhaṁ dhīraṁ so ’mṛitatvāya kalpate
english_translation: The hero whose soul is unmoved by circumstances, who accepts pleasure and pain with equanimity, is only fit for immortality.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः। उभयोरपि दृष्टोऽन्तस्त्वनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः।।
transliteration_iast: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ ubhayorapi dṛiṣhṭo ’nta stvanayos tattva-darśhibhiḥ
english_translation: That which is not shall never be; that which is shall never cease to be. These truths are self-evident to the wise.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्। विनाशमव्ययस्यास्य न कश्िचत् कर्तुमर्हति।।
transliteration_iast: avināśhi tu tadviddhi yena sarvam idaṁ tatam vināśham avyayasyāsya na kaśhchit kartum arhati
english_translation: The Spirit, which pervades all that is seen, is imperishable. Nothing can destroy it.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः। अनाशिनोऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत।।
transliteration_iast: antavanta ime dehā nityasyoktāḥ śharīriṇaḥ anāśhino ’prameyasya tasmād yudhyasva bhārata
english_translation: The material bodies that this Eternal, Indestructible, and Immeasurable Spirit inhabits are all finite; therefore, fight, O valiant man!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम्। उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते।।
transliteration_iast: ya enaṁ vetti hantāraṁ yaśh chainaṁ manyate hatam ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṁ hanti na hanyate
english_translation: He who thinks that the Spirit kills, and he who thinks of it as killed, are both ignorant. The Spirit neither kills nor is it killed.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचि न्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः। अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे।।
transliteration_iast: na jāyate mriyate vā kadāchin nāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ ajo nityaḥ śhāśhvato ’yaṁ purāṇo na hanyate hanyamāne śharīre
english_translation: It was not born; it will never die, nor, once having been, can it cease to exist. Unborn, eternal, ever-enduring, yet most ancient, the spirit does not die when the body is dead.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनमजमव्ययम्। कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम्।।
transliteration_iast: vedāvināśhinaṁ nityaṁ ya enam ajam avyayam kathaṁ sa puruṣhaḥ pārtha kaṁ ghātayati hanti kam
english_translation: He who knows the Spirit to be indestructible, immortal, unborn, and always the same, how should he kill or cause to be killed?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि। तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णा न्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही।।
transliteration_iast: vāsānsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya navāni gṛihṇāti naro ’parāṇi tathā śharīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇānya nyāni sanyāti navāni dehī
english_translation: As a man discards his threadbare robes and puts on new ones, so the Spirit throws off its worn-out bodies and takes on fresh ones.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः। न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्यापो न शोषयति मारुतः।।
transliteration_iast: nainaṁ chhindanti śhastrāṇi nainaṁ dahati pāvakaḥ na chainaṁ kledayantyāpo na śhoṣhayati mārutaḥ
english_translation: Weapons cannot cleave it, fire cannot burn it, water cannot drench it, and wind cannot dry it.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अच्छेद्योऽयमदाह्योऽयमक्लेद्योऽशोष्य एव च। नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुरचलोऽयं सनातनः।।
transliteration_iast: achchhedyo ’yam adāhyo ’yam akledyo ’śhoṣhya eva cha nityaḥ sarva-gataḥ sthāṇur achalo ’yaṁ sanātanaḥ
english_translation: It is impenetrable; it cannot be drowned, scorched, or dried. It is eternal, all-pervasive, unchanging, immovable, and most ancient.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अव्यक्तोऽयमचिन्त्योऽयमविकार्योऽयमुच्यते। तस्मादेवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुमर्हसि।।
transliteration_iast: avyakto ’yam achintyo ’yam avikāryo ’yam uchyate tasmādevaṁ viditvainaṁ nānuśhochitum arhasi
english_translation: It is named the Unmanifest, the Unthinkable, and the immutable. Therefore, knowing the Spirit as such, you have no cause to grieve.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्। तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि।।
transliteration_iast: atha chainaṁ nitya-jātaṁ nityaṁ vā manyase mṛitam tathāpi tvaṁ mahā-bāho naivaṁ śhochitum arhasi
english_translation: Even if thou thinkest of it as constantly being born and constantly dying, O Mighty Man, thou still hast no cause to grieve.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च। तस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि।।
transliteration_iast: jātasya hi dhruvo mṛityur dhruvaṁ janma mṛitasya cha tasmād aparihārye ’rthe na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi
english_translation: For death is certain for that which is born, just as birth is certain for that which is dead. Therefore, do not grieve for what is inevitable.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत। अव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना।।
transliteration_iast: avyaktādīni bhūtāni vyakta-madhyāni bhārata avyakta-nidhanānyeva tatra kā paridevanā
english_translation: The end and beginning of beings are unknown; we only see the intervening formations. So, what is there to grieve about?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्िचदेन माश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः। आश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः श्रृणोति श्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्िचत्।।
transliteration_iast: āśhcharya-vat paśhyati kaśhchid enan āśhcharya-vad vadati tathaiva chānyaḥ āśhcharya-vach chainam anyaḥ śhṛiṇoti śhrutvāpyenaṁ veda na chaiva kaśhchit
english_translation: One hears of the Spirit with surprise, another thinks it marvelous, the third listens without comprehending. Thus, though many are told about it, scarcely is there one who knows it.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत। तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि।।
transliteration_iast: dehī nityam avadhyo ’yaṁ dehe sarvasya bhārata tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi
english_translation: Do not be anxious about these armies; the spirit in man is imperishable.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि। धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाछ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते।।
transliteration_iast: swa-dharmam api chāvekṣhya na vikampitum arhasi dharmyāddhi yuddhāch chhreyo ’nyat kṣhatriyasya na vidyate
english_translation: You must look at your duty. Nothing can be more welcome to a soldier than a righteous war. Therefore, wavering in this resolve is unworthy, O Arjuna!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्। सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्।।
transliteration_iast: yadṛichchhayā chopapannaṁ swarga-dvāram apāvṛitam sukhinaḥ kṣhatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddham īdṛiśham
english_translation: Blessed are the soldiers who find their opportunity; this opportunity has opened for thee the gates of heaven.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि। ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि।।
transliteration_iast: atha chet tvam imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣhyasi tataḥ sva-dharmaṁ kīrtiṁ cha hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi
english_translation: Refuse to fight in this righteous cause, and you will be a traitor, losing fame, incurring only sin.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्। संभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: akīrtiṁ chāpi bhūtāni kathayiṣhyanti te ’vyayām sambhāvitasya chākīrtir maraṇād atirichyate
english_translation: Men will talk forever of thy disgrace; and to the noble, dishonor is worse than death.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः। येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्।।
transliteration_iast: bhayād raṇād uparataṁ mansyante tvāṁ mahā-rathāḥ yeṣhāṁ cha tvaṁ bahu-mato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam
english_translation: Great generals will think that you have fled from the battlefield out of cowardice; though once honored, you will seem despicable.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून् वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः। निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्।।
transliteration_iast: avāchya-vādānśh cha bahūn vadiṣhyanti tavāhitāḥ nindantastava sāmarthyaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim
english_translation: Your enemies will spread scandal and mock your courage. Is there anything more humiliating?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्। तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः।।
transliteration_iast: hato vā prāpsyasi swargaṁ jitvā vā bhokṣhyase mahīm tasmād uttiṣhṭha kaunteya yuddhāya kṛita-niśhchayaḥ
english_translation: If you are killed, you will attain Heaven; if you are victorious, you will enjoy the kingdom of earth. Therefore, arise, O Son of Kunti, and fight!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ। ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि।।
transliteration_iast: sukha-duḥkhe same kṛitvā lābhālābhau jayājayau tato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṁ pāpam avāpsyasi
english_translation: Look upon pleasure and pain, victory and defeat, with an equal eye. Be prepared for the combat, and you will commit no sin.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां श्रृणु। बुद्ध्यायुक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि।।
transliteration_iast: eṣhā te ’bhihitā sānkhye buddhir yoge tvimāṁ śhṛiṇu buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha karma-bandhaṁ prahāsyasi
english_translation: I have told you the philosophy of knowledge. Now, listen, and I will explain the philosophy of action, by means of which, O Arjuna, you will break through the bondage of all action.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते। स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात्।।
transliteration_iast: nehābhikrama-nāśho ’sti pratyavāyo na vidyate svalpam apyasya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt
english_translation: On this path, endeavour is never wasted nor repressed. Even a little practice of it protects one from great danger.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन। बहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्।।
transliteration_iast: vyavasāyātmikā buddhir ekeha kuru-nandana bahu-śhākhā hyanantāśh cha buddhayo ’vyavasāyinām
english_translation: By its means, the straying intellect becomes steadied in contemplating one object only; whereas the minds of the irresolute stray into innumerable bypaths.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यामिमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्यविपश्िचतः। वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यदस्तीति वादिनः।।
transliteration_iast: yāmimāṁ puṣhpitāṁ vāchaṁ pravadanty-avipaśhchitaḥ veda-vāda-ratāḥ pārtha nānyad astīti vādinaḥ kāmātmānaḥ swarga-parā janma-karma-phala-pradām kriyā-viśheṣha-bahulāṁ bhogaiśhwarya-gatiṁ prati
english_translation: Only the ignorant speak in figurative language; it is they who extol the letter of the scriptures, saying, "There is nothing deeper than this."
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम्। क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति।।
transliteration_iast: kāmātmānaḥ svarga-parā janma-karma-phala-pradām kriyā-viśeṣa-bahulāṁ bhogaiśvarya-gatiṁ prati
english_translation: Consulting only their own desires, they construct their own heaven, devising arduous and complex rites to secure their own pleasure and power; and the only result is rebirth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम्। व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते।।
transliteration_iast: bhogaiśwvarya-prasaktānāṁ tayāpahṛita-chetasām vyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ samādhau na vidhīyate
english_translation: While their minds are absorbed with thoughts of power and personal enjoyment, they cannot focus their discrimination on one point.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन। निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान्।।
transliteration_iast: trai-guṇya-viṣhayā vedā nistrai-guṇyo bhavārjuna nirdvandvo nitya-sattva-stho niryoga-kṣhema ātmavān
english_translation: The Vedic Scriptures tell of the three constituents of life—the Qualities. Rise above all of them, O Arjuna, above all the pairs of opposing sensations; be steadfast in truth, free from worldly anxieties, and centered in the Self.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यावानर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः संप्लुतोदके। तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः।।
transliteration_iast: yāvān artha udapāne sarvataḥ samplutodake tāvānsarveṣhu vedeṣhu brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ
english_translation: As a man can drink water from any side of a full tank, so the skilled theologian can extract from any scripture that which will serve their purpose.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि।।
transliteration_iast: karmaṇy-evādhikāras te mā phaleṣhu kadāchana mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo ’stvakarmaṇi
english_translation: But you have only the right to work, but none to the fruit of it. Let not the fruit of your action be your motive; nor be you enamored of inaction.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yoga-sthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga uchyate
english_translation: Revised: Perform all your actions with your mind concentrated on the Divine, renouncing attachment and looking upon success and failure with an equal eye. Spirituality implies equanimity.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनञ्जय। बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः।।
transliteration_iast: dūreṇa hy-avaraṁ karma buddhi-yogād dhanañjaya buddhau śharaṇam anvichchha kṛipaṇāḥ phala-hetavaḥ
english_translation: Physical action is far inferior to an intellect concentrated on the Divine. Therefore, have recourse to Pure Intelligence. It is only the small-minded who work for reward.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते। तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्।।
transliteration_iast: buddhi-yukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛita-duṣhkṛite tasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśhalam
english_translation: When a person attains Pure Reason, they renounce in this world the results of both good and evil. Cling to Right Action. Spirituality is the true art of living.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः। जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम्।।
transliteration_iast: karma-jaṁ buddhi-yuktā hi phalaṁ tyaktvā manīṣhiṇaḥ janma-bandha-vinirmuktāḥ padaṁ gachchhanty-anāmayam
english_translation: The sages, guided by pure intellect, renounce the fruits of their actions; and, thus freed from the shackles of rebirth, they attain the highest bliss.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति। तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च।।
transliteration_iast: yadā te moha-kalilaṁ buddhir vyatitariṣhyati tadā gantāsi nirvedaṁ śhrotavyasya śhrutasya cha
english_translation: When your reason has crossed the entanglements of illusion, then you will become indifferent to both the philosophies you have heard and those you may yet hear.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला। समाधावचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगमवाप्स्यसि।।
transliteration_iast: śhruti-vipratipannā te yadā sthāsyati niśhchalā samādhāv-achalā buddhis tadā yogam avāpsyasi
english_translation: When the intellect, bewildered by the multiplicity of holy scriptures, stands unperturbed in blissful contemplation of the infinite, then you have attained spirituality.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव। स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम्।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha sthita-prajñasya kā bhāṣhā samādhi-sthasya keśhava sthita-dhīḥ kiṁ prabhāṣheta kim āsīta vrajeta kim
english_translation: Arjuna asked: My Lord! How can we recognize the saint who has attained Pure Intellect, who has reached this state of Bliss, and whose mind is steady? How does he talk, how does he live, and how does he act?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच प्रजहाति यदा कामान् सर्वान् पार्थ मनोगतान्। आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha prajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha mano-gatān ātmany-evātmanā tuṣhṭaḥ sthita-prajñas tadochyate
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: When a person has given up the desires of their heart and is content with the Self alone, they have surely reached the highest state.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः। वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: duḥkheṣhv-anudvigna-manāḥ sukheṣhu vigata-spṛihaḥ vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhaḥ sthita-dhīr munir uchyate
english_translation: The sage whose mind is unruffled in suffering, whose desire is not aroused by enjoyment, who is without attachment, anger, or fear—take him to be one who stands at a lofty level.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम्। नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।
transliteration_iast: yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehas tat tat prāpya śhubhāśhubham nābhinandati na dveṣhṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
english_translation: He who, wherever he goes, is not attached to any person or place by ties of flesh; who accepts good and evil alike, neither welcoming the one nor shrinking from the other—take him to be one who is merged in the Infinite.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।
transliteration_iast: yadā sanharate chāyaṁ kūrmo ’ṅgānīva sarvaśhaḥ indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
english_translation: He who can withdraw his senses from the attraction of their objects, as the tortoise draws its limbs within its shell—take it that such a one has attained perfection.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः। रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते।।
transliteration_iast: viṣhayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ rasa-varjaṁ raso ’pyasya paraṁ dṛiṣhṭvā nivartate
english_translation: The objects of sense turn away from him who is abstinent. Even the taste for them is lost in him who has seen the Truth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्िचतः। इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः।।
transliteration_iast: yatato hyapi kaunteya puruṣhasya vipaśhchitaḥ indriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṁ manaḥ
english_translation: O Arjuna! The mind of one who is attempting to conquer it is forcibly carried away, in spite of their efforts, by their tumultuous senses.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः। वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।
transliteration_iast: tāni sarvāṇi sanyamya yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ vaśhe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
english_translation: Restraining them all, let him steadfastly meditate on Me; for whoever conquers their senses achieves perfection.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते। सङ्गात् संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते।।
transliteration_iast: dhyāyato viṣhayān puṁsaḥ saṅgas teṣhūpajāyate saṅgāt sañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho ’bhijāyate
english_translation: When a person dwells on the objects of sense, they create an attraction for them; this attraction develops into desire, and desire breeds anger.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः। स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति।।
transliteration_iast: krodhād bhavati sammohaḥ sammohāt smṛiti-vibhramaḥ smṛiti-bhranśhād buddhi-nāśho buddhi-nāśhāt praṇaśhyati
english_translation: Anger induces delusion; delusion leads to loss of memory; loss of memory results in the shattering of reason; and the destruction of reason leads to destruction.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: रागद्वेषवियुक्तैस्तु विषयानिन्द्रियैश्चरन्। आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: rāga-dveṣha-viyuktais tu viṣhayān indriyaiśh charan ātma-vaśhyair-vidheyātmā prasādam adhigachchhati
english_translation: But the self-controlled soul, who moves among sense objects, free from attachment or repulsion, wins eternal peace.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते। प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते।।
transliteration_iast: prasāde sarva-duḥkhānāṁ hānir asyopajāyate prasanna-chetaso hyāśhu buddhiḥ paryavatiṣhṭhate
english_translation: Having attained peace, he becomes free from misery; for when the mind gains peace, right discrimination follows.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना। न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम्।।
transliteration_iast: nāsti buddhir-ayuktasya na chāyuktasya bhāvanā na chābhāvayataḥ śhāntir aśhāntasya kutaḥ sukham
english_translation: Right discrimination is not for him who cannot concentrate. Without concentration, there cannot be meditation; he who cannot meditate must not expect peace; and without peace, how can one expect happiness?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनोऽनुविधीयते। तदस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावमिवाम्भसि।।
transliteration_iast: indriyāṇāṁ hi charatāṁ yan mano ’nuvidhīyate tadasya harati prajñāṁ vāyur nāvam ivāmbhasi
english_translation: As a ship at sea is tossed by the tempest, so the reason is carried away by the mind when preyed upon by straying senses.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता।।
transliteration_iast: tasmād yasya mahā-bāho nigṛihītāni sarvaśhaḥ indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣhṭhitā
english_translation: Therefore, O Mighty-Armed One, he whose senses are detached from their objects—take it that his reason is purified.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी। यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः।।
transliteration_iast: yā niśhā sarva-bhūtānāṁ tasyāṁ jāgarti sanyamī yasyāṁ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśhā paśhyato muneḥ
english_translation: The saint is awake when the world sleeps, and he disregards that for which the world lives.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्। तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी।।
transliteration_iast: āpūryamāṇam achala-pratiṣhṭhaṁ samudram āpaḥ praviśhanti yadvat tadvat kāmā yaṁ praviśhanti sarve sa śhāntim āpnoti na kāma-kāmī
english_translation: He attains peace into whom desires flow as rivers into the ocean, which, though brimming with water, remains ever the same; not he whom desires carry away.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः। निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शांतिमधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumānśh charati niḥspṛihaḥ nirmamo nirahankāraḥ sa śhāntim adhigachchhati
english_translation: He attains peace who, giving up desire, moves through the world without aspiration, possessing nothing that he can call his own and is free from pride.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति। स्थित्वाऽस्यामन्तकालेऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: eṣhā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṁ prāpya vimuhyati sthitvāsyām anta-kāle ’pi brahma-nirvāṇam ṛichchhati
english_translation: O Arjuna! This is the state of the Self, the Supreme Spirit, to which, if one attains, it shall never be taken away. Even at the time of leaving the body, one will remain firmly enthroned there and become one with the Eternal.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन। तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha jyāyasī chet karmaṇas te matā buddhir janārdana tat kiṁ karmaṇi ghore māṁ niyojayasi keśhava
english_translation: Arjuna questioned: My Lord! If wisdom is superior to action, why do you advise me to engage in this terrible fight?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे। तदेकं वद निश्िचत्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम्।।
transliteration_iast: vyāmiśhreṇeva vākyena buddhiṁ mohayasīva me tad ekaṁ vada niśhchitya yena śhreyo ’ham āpnuyām
english_translation: Your language confuses me and confounds my reason. Therefore, please tell me the only way by which I can, without doubt, secure my spiritual welfare.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच लोकेऽस्मिन्द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ। ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha loke’smin dvi-vidhā niṣhṭhā purā proktā mayānagha jñāna-yogena sāṅkhyānāṁ karma-yogena yoginām
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: In this world, as I have said, there is a twofold path, O sinless one! There is the path of wisdom for those who meditate, and the path of action for those who work.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽश्नुते। न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: na karmaṇām anārambhān naiṣhkarmyaṁ puruṣho ’śhnute na cha sannyasanād eva siddhiṁ samadhigachchhati
english_translation: No one can attain freedom from action by abstaining from action, nor can they reach perfection by simply not acting.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न हि कश्िचत्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्। कार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः।।
transliteration_iast: na hi kaśhchit kṣhaṇam api jātu tiṣhṭhatyakarma-kṛit kāryate hyavaśhaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛiti-jair guṇaiḥ
english_translation: He cannot remain inactive even for a moment, for the qualities of Nature will compel him to act, whether he wills it or not.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्। इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: karmendriyāṇi sanyamya ya āste manasā smaran indriyārthān vimūḍhātmā mithyāchāraḥ sa uchyate
english_translation: He who remains motionless, refusing to act, yet brooding over sensuous objects, is that deluded soul simply a hypocrite.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन। कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yas tvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate ’rjuna karmendriyaiḥ karma-yogam asaktaḥ sa viśhiṣhyate
english_translation: But, O Arjuna! All honor to him whose mind controls his senses, for he is thereby beginning to practice Karma-Yoga, the Path of Right Action, keeping himself always unattached.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः। शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः।।
transliteration_iast: niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ śharīra-yātrāpi cha te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ
english_translation: Do your duty as prescribed, for action for duty's sake is superior to inaction. Even the maintenance of the body would be impossible if one remained inactive.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः। तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसंगः समाचर।।
transliteration_iast: yajñārthāt karmaṇo ’nyatra loko ’yaṁ karma-bandhanaḥ tad-arthaṁ karma kaunteya mukta-saṅgaḥ samāchara
english_translation: In this world, people are fettered by their actions, unless they are performed as a sacrifice. Therefore, O Arjuna, let your actions be done without attachment, as a sacrifice only.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः। अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्।।
transliteration_iast: saha-yajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛiṣhṭvā purovācha prajāpatiḥ anena prasaviṣhyadhvam eṣha vo ’stviṣhṭa-kāma-dhuk
english_translation: In the beginning, when God created all beings through the sacrifice of Himself, He said to them: "You can procreate through sacrifice, and it shall satisfy all your desires."
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः। परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ।।
transliteration_iast: devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ parasparaṁ bhāvayantaḥ śhreyaḥ param avāpsyatha
english_translation: Worship the powers of Nature, and let them nourish you in return; thus, supporting each other, you shall attain your highest welfare.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः। तैर्दत्तानप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः।।
transliteration_iast: iṣhṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajña-bhāvitāḥ tair dattān apradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ
english_translation: For, fed by sacrifice, nature will give you all the enjoyment you desire. But he who enjoys what she gives without returning is, indeed, a thief.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः। भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्।।
transliteration_iast: yajña-śhiṣhṭāśhinaḥ santo muchyante sarva-kilbiṣhaiḥ bhuñjate te tvaghaṁ pāpā ye pachantyātma-kāraṇāt
english_translation: The sages who enjoy the food that remains after the sacrifice is made are freed from all sins; whereas, the selfish who spread their feast only for themselves feed on sin alone.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्यादन्नसम्भवः। यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः।।
transliteration_iast: annād bhavanti bhūtāni parjanyād anna-sambhavaḥ yajñād bhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karma-samudbhavaḥ
english_translation: All creatures are the product of food; food is the product of rain; rain comes from sacrifice, and sacrifice is the noblest form of action.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्। तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्।।
transliteration_iast: karma brahmodbhavaṁ viddhi brahmākṣhara-samudbhavam tasmāt sarva-gataṁ brahma nityaṁ yajñe pratiṣhṭhitam
english_translation: All actions originate from the Supreme Spirit, which is Imperishable, and in sacrificial actions, the all-pervasive Spirit is consciously present.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः। अघायुरिन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति।।
transliteration_iast: evaṁ pravartitaṁ chakraṁ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ aghāyur indriyārāmo moghaṁ pārtha sa jīvati
english_translation: Thus, he who does not help the revolving wheel of sacrifice, but instead leads a sinful life, rejoicing in the gratification of his senses, O Arjuna, is breathing in vain.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यस्त्वात्मरतिरेव स्यादात्मतृप्तश्च मानवः। आत्मन्येव च सन्तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yas tvātma-ratir eva syād ātma-tṛiptaśh cha mānavaḥ ātmanyeva cha santuṣhṭas tasya kāryaṁ na vidyate
english_translation: On the other hand, the soul who meditates on the Self is content to serve the Self and rests satisfied in the Self; there is nothing more for them to accomplish.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन। न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्िचदर्थव्यपाश्रयः।।
transliteration_iast: naiva tasya kṛitenārtho nākṛiteneha kaśhchana na chāsya sarva-bhūteṣhu kaśhchid artha-vyapāśhrayaḥ
english_translation: He has nothing to gain from the performance or non-performance of action; his welfare does not depend on any contribution that an earthly creature can make.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर। असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः।।
transliteration_iast: tasmād asaktaḥ satataṁ kāryaṁ karma samāchara asakto hyācharan karma param āpnoti pūruṣhaḥ
english_translation: Therefore, do your duty perfectly, without worrying about the results, for he who does his duty without attachment attains the Supreme.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिमास्थिता जनकादयः। लोकसंग्रहमेवापि संपश्यन्कर्तुमर्हसि।।
transliteration_iast: karmaṇaiva hi sansiddhim āsthitā janakādayaḥ loka-saṅgraham evāpi sampaśhyan kartum arhasi
english_translation: King Janaka and others attained perfection through action alone. Even for the sake of enlightening the world, it is your duty to act.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः। स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते।।
transliteration_iast: yad yad ācharati śhreṣhṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ sa yat pramāṇaṁ kurute lokas tad anuvartate
english_translation: For whatever a great man does, others imitate; people conform to the standard he has set.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किञ्चन। नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि।।
transliteration_iast: na me pārthāsti kartavyaṁ triṣhu lokeṣhu kiñchana nānavāptam avāptavyaṁ varta eva cha karmaṇi
english_translation: There is nothing in this universe, O Arjuna, that I am compelled to do, nor anything for me to attain; yet I persistently remain active.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः। मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः।।
transliteration_iast: yadi hyahaṁ na varteyaṁ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ
english_translation: Were I not to act without ceasing, O prince, people would be inclined to do the same.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम्। सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः।।
