transliteration_iast: utsīdeyur ime lokā na kuryāṁ karma ched aham sankarasya cha kartā syām upahanyām imāḥ prajāḥ
english_translation: And if I were to refrain from action, the human race would be ruined; I would lead the world to chaos, and destruction would follow.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सक्ताः कर्मण्यविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत। कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्िचकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम्।।
transliteration_iast: saktāḥ karmaṇyavidvānso yathā kurvanti bhārata kuryād vidvāns tathāsaktaśh chikīrṣhur loka-saṅgraham
english_translation: As the ignorant act, out of their fondness for action, so should the wise act without attachment, fixing their eyes, O Arjuna, only on the welfare of the world.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेदज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम्। जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान् युक्तः समाचरन्।।
transliteration_iast: na buddhi-bhedaṁ janayed ajñānāṁ karma-saṅginām joṣhayet sarva-karmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācharan
english_translation: But a wise man should not disturb the minds of the ignorant, who are attached to action; let him perform his own actions in the right spirit, with concentration on Me, thus inspiring all others to do the same.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः। अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताऽहमिति मन्यते।।
transliteration_iast: prakṛiteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśhaḥ ahankāra-vimūḍhātmā kartāham iti manyate
english_translation: Action is the product of the qualities inherent in nature. It is only the ignorant man who, misled by personal egotism, says, "I am the doer."
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः। गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते।।
transliteration_iast: tattva-vit tu mahā-bāho guṇa-karma-vibhāgayoḥ guṇā guṇeṣhu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate
english_translation: But he, O Mighty One, who correctly understands the relationship between the Qualities and action, is not attached to the act, for he perceives that it is merely the action and reaction of the Qualities among themselves.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृतेर्गुणसम्मूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु। तानकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत्।।
transliteration_iast: prakṛiter guṇa-sammūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇa-karmasu tān akṛitsna-vido mandān kṛitsna-vin na vichālayet
english_translation: Those who do not understand the qualities are interested in the act; however, the wise man who knows the truth should not disturb the mind of those who do not.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा। निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः।।
transliteration_iast: mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi sannyasyādhyātma-chetasā nirāśhīr nirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigata-jvaraḥ
english_translation: Therefore, surrender your actions to Me, keep your thoughts focused on the Absolute, free from selfishness and without expecting a reward, with a mind free from excitement, begin to fight.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ये मे मतमिदं नित्यमनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः। श्रद्धावन्तोऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते तेऽपि कर्मभिः।।
transliteration_iast: ye me matam idaṁ nityam anutiṣhṭhanti mānavāḥ śhraddhāvanto ’nasūyanto muchyante te ’pi karmabhiḥ
english_translation: Those who always act in accordance with My precepts, firmly in faith and without caviling, they too are freed from the bondage of action.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ये त्वेतदभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम्। सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टानचेतसः।।
transliteration_iast: ye tvetad abhyasūyanto nānutiṣhṭhanti me matam sarva-jñāna-vimūḍhāns tān viddhi naṣhṭān achetasaḥ
english_translation: But they who ridicule My word and do not observe it, are ignorant, devoid of wisdom, and blind. They seek only their own destruction.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवानपि। प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति।।
transliteration_iast: sadṛiśhaṁ cheṣhṭate svasyāḥ prakṛiter jñānavān api prakṛitiṁ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṁ kariṣhyati
english_translation: Even the wise man acts in accordance with his nature; indeed, all creatures act according to their natures. What is the use of compulsion then?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ। तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ।।
transliteration_iast: indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāga-dveṣhau vyavasthitau tayor na vaśham āgachchhet tau hyasya paripanthinau
english_translation: The love and hate that are aroused by the objects of sense arise from Nature; do not yield to them, as they only obstruct the path.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः।।
transliteration_iast: śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt swa-dharme nidhanaṁ śhreyaḥ para-dharmo bhayāvahaḥ
english_translation: It is better to do one's own duty, however lacking in merit, than to do that of another, even though efficiently. It is better to die doing one's own duty, for doing the duty of another is fraught with danger.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच अथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः। अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha atha kena prayukto ’yaṁ pāpaṁ charati pūruṣhaḥ anichchhann api vārṣhṇeya balād iva niyojitaḥ
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, what is it that drives a person to sin, even against their will and as if by compulsion?"
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः। महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha kāma eṣha krodha eṣha rajo-guṇa-samudbhavaḥ mahāśhano mahā-pāpmā viddhyenam iha vairiṇam
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna: It is desire, it is aversion, born of passion. Desire consumes and corrupts all things. It is the greatest enemy of man.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथाऽऽदर्शो मलेन च। यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदमावृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: dhūmenāvriyate vahnir yathādarśho malena cha yatholbenāvṛito garbhas tathā tenedam āvṛitam
english_translation: As fire is shrouded by smoke, a mirror is covered by dust, and a child is enveloped by the womb, so is the universe enveloped in desire.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा। कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च।।
transliteration_iast: āvṛitaṁ jñānam etena jñānino nitya-vairiṇā kāma-rūpeṇa kaunteya duṣhpūreṇānalena cha
english_translation: It is the wise man's constant enemy; it tarnishes the face of wisdom, being as insatiable as a flame of fire.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते। एतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्।।
transliteration_iast: indriyāṇi mano buddhir asyādhiṣhṭhānam uchyate etair vimohayatyeṣha jñānam āvṛitya dehinam
english_translation: It works through the senses, the mind, and the reason; and with their help, it destroys wisdom and confounds the soul.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ। पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम्।।
transliteration_iast: tasmāt tvam indriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣhabha pāpmānaṁ prajahi hyenaṁ jñāna-vijñāna-nāśhanam
english_translation: Therefore, O Arjuna, first control your senses and then slay desire, for it is full of sin and is the destroyer of knowledge and wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः। मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः।।
transliteration_iast: indriyāṇi parāṇyāhur indriyebhyaḥ paraṁ manaḥ manasas tu parā buddhir yo buddheḥ paratas tu saḥ
english_translation: It is said that the senses are powerful; however, beyond the senses is the mind, beyond the mind is the intellect, and greater than the intellect is He.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना। जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम्।।
transliteration_iast: evaṁ buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā sanstabhyātmānam ātmanā jahi śhatruṁ mahā-bāho kāma-rūpaṁ durāsadam
english_translation: Thus, O Mighty-Armed One, knowing Him to be beyond the intellect, and with His help, subdue your personal ego and kill your enemy, Desire, even though it is extremely difficult.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्। विवस्वान् मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha imaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam vivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣhvākave ’bravīt
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: I taught this imperishable philosophy to Vivaswān, the founder of the Sun dynasty; Vivaswān gave it to Manu, the lawgiver, and Manu to King Ikshvāku.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः। स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप।।
transliteration_iast: evaṁ paramparā-prāptam imaṁ rājarṣhayo viduḥ sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣhṭaḥ parantapa
english_translation: The Divine Kings knew it, for it was their tradition; then, after a long time, it was at last forgotten.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः। भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्।।
transliteration_iast: sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ bhakto ’si me sakhā cheti rahasyaṁ hyetad uttamam
english_translation: It is the same ancient path that I have now revealed to you, for you are my devotee and my friend. It is the supreme secret.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः। कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha aparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ katham etad vijānīyāṁ tvam ādau proktavān iti
english_translation: Arjuna asked: My Lord! Vyasawana was born before You; how then can You have revealed it to him?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन। तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava chārjuna tānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: I have been born again and again, from time to time; thou too, O Arjuna! My births are known to me, but yours are unknown to you.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्। प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया।।
transliteration_iast: ajo ’pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānām īśhvaro ’pi san prakṛitiṁ svām adhiṣhṭhāya sambhavāmyātma-māyayā
english_translation: There is no beginning to Me. Though I am imperishable and the Lord of all that exists, I manifest Myself by My own will and power.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत। अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम्।।
transliteration_iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛijāmyaham
english_translation: Whenever spirituality decays and materialism is rampant, then, O Arjuna, I reincarnate myself.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम्। धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे।।
transliteration_iast: paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṁ vināśhāya cha duṣhkṛitām dharma-sansthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge
english_translation: To protect the righteous, to destroy the wicked, and to establish the kingdom of God, I am reborn from age to age.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः। त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन।।
transliteration_iast: janma karma cha me divyam evaṁ yo vetti tattvataḥ tyaktvā dehaṁ punar janma naiti mām eti so ’rjuna
english_translation: He who realizes the divine truth concerning My birth and life does not take birth again; and when he leaves his body, he becomes one with Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः। बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः।।
transliteration_iast: vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhā man-mayā mām upāśhritāḥ bahavo jñāna-tapasā pūtā mad-bhāvam āgatāḥ
english_translation: Many have merged their existences in Mine, being freed from desire, fear, and anger, always filled with Me and purified by the illuminating flame of self-abnegation.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्। मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः।।
transliteration_iast: ye yathā māṁ prapadyante tāns tathaiva bhajāmyaham mama vartmānuvartante manuṣhyāḥ pārtha sarvaśhaḥ
english_translation: However men try to worship Me, I welcome them. Whatever path they take, it leads to Me in the end.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः। क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा।।
transliteration_iast: kāṅkṣhantaḥ karmaṇāṁ siddhiṁ yajanta iha devatāḥ kṣhipraṁ hi mānuṣhe loke siddhir bhavati karmajā
english_translation: Those who seek success worship the Powers, and their actions in this world bear immediate fruit.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः। तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम्।।
transliteration_iast: chātur-varṇyaṁ mayā sṛiṣhṭaṁ guṇa-karma-vibhāgaśhaḥ tasya kartāram api māṁ viddhyakartāram avyayam
english_translation: The four divisions of society—the wise, the soldier, the merchant, and the laborer—were created by Me, according to the natural distribution of qualities and instincts. I am the author of them, though I Myself do not act and am changeless.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा। इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते।।
transliteration_iast: na māṁ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛihā iti māṁ yo ’bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate
english_translation: My actions do not bind Me, nor do I desire anything that they can bring. He who thus realizes Me is not enslaved by action.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः। कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: evaṁ jñātvā kṛitaṁ karma pūrvair api mumukṣhubhiḥ kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṁ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṁ kṛitam
english_translation: In the light of wisdom, our ancestors who sought deliverance performed their acts. Act thou also as our fathers of old did.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः। तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्।।
transliteration_iast: kiṁ karma kim akarmeti kavayo ’pyatra mohitāḥ tat te karma pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvā mokṣhyase ’śhubhāt
english_translation: What is action and what is inaction? This is a question that has bewildered the wise. But I will declare to you the philosophy of action, and knowing it, you will be free from evil.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः। अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः।।
transliteration_iast: karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṁ boddhavyaṁ cha vikarmaṇaḥ akarmaṇaśh cha boddhavyaṁ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ
english_translation: It is necessary to consider what is right action, what is wrong action, and what is inaction, for the law of action is mysterious.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः। स बुद्धिमान् मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्।।
transliteration_iast: karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśhyed akarmaṇi cha karma yaḥ sa buddhimān manuṣhyeṣhu sa yuktaḥ kṛitsna-karma-kṛit
english_translation: He who can see inaction in action, and action in inaction, is the wisest among men. He is a saint, even though he still acts.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः। ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः।।
transliteration_iast: yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāma-saṅkalpa-varjitāḥ jñānāgni-dagdha-karmāṇaṁ tam āhuḥ paṇḍitaṁ budhāḥ
english_translation: The wise call him a sage, for whatever he undertakes is free from the motive of desire, and his deeds are purified by the fire of wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः। कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः।।
transliteration_iast: tyaktvā karma-phalāsaṅgaṁ nitya-tṛipto nirāśhrayaḥ karmaṇyabhipravṛitto ’pi naiva kiñchit karoti saḥ
english_translation: Having surrendered all claim to the results of his actions, he is always contented and independent; in reality, he does nothing, even though he appears to be acting.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः। शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्।।
transliteration_iast: nirāśhīr yata-chittātmā tyakta-sarva-parigrahaḥ śhārīraṁ kevalaṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham
english_translation: Expecting nothing, his mind and personality controlled, without greed, doing only bodily actions; though he acts, he remains untainted.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः। समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yadṛichchhā-lābha-santuṣhṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau cha kṛitvāpi na nibadhyate
english_translation: Content with what comes to him without any effort of his own, rising above the pairs of opposites, free from envy, his mind balanced in both success and failure; though he acts, the consequences do not bind him.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः। यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते।।
transliteration_iast: gata-saṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthita-chetasaḥ yajñāyācharataḥ karma samagraṁ pravilīyate
english_translation: He who is without attachment, free, his mind centered in wisdom, and his actions done as a sacrifice, leave no trace behind.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्महविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम्। ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना।।
transliteration_iast: brahmārpaṇaṁ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam brahmaiva tena gantavyaṁ brahma-karma-samādhinā
english_translation: For him, the sacrifice is the Spirit; the Spirit and the offering are one; it is the Spirit that is sacrificed in its own fire, and the man, even in action, is united with God, since his mind never ceases to be fixed on Him while performing the act.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते। ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति।।
transliteration_iast: daivam evāpare yajñaṁ yoginaḥ paryupāsate brahmāgnāvapare yajñaṁ yajñenaivopajuhvati
english_translation: Some sages sacrifice to the powers, while others offer themselves on the altar of the eternal.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति। शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति।।
transliteration_iast: śhrotrādīnīndriyāṇyanye sanyamāgniṣhu juhvati śhabdādīn viṣhayānanya indriyāgniṣhu juhvati
english_translation: Some sacrifice their physical senses in the fire of self-control; others offer up their contact with external objects in the sacrificial fire of their senses.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे। आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते।।
transliteration_iast: sarvāṇīndriya-karmāṇi prāṇa-karmāṇi chāpare ātma-sanyama-yogāgnau juhvati jñāna-dīpite
english_translation: Others again sacrifice their activities and vitality in the spiritual fire of self-abnegation, kindled by wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे। स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः।।
transliteration_iast: dravya-yajñās tapo-yajñā yoga-yajñās tathāpare swādhyāya-jñāna-yajñāśh cha yatayaḥ sanśhita-vratāḥ
english_translation: Others offer as their sacrifice wealth, austerities, and meditation. Monks, wedded to their vows, renounce their scriptural learning and even their spiritual powers.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अपाने जुह्वति प्राण प्राणेऽपानं तथाऽपरे। प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः।।
transliteration_iast: apāne juhvati prāṇaṁ prāṇe ’pānaṁ tathāpare prāṇāpāna-gatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāma-parāyaṇāḥ apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣhu juhvati sarve ’pyete yajña-vido yajña-kṣhapita-kalmaṣhāḥ
english_translation: There are some who practice controlling the vital energy and governing the subtle forces of prana and apana, thereby sacrificing their prana to apana, or their apana to prana.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति। सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः।।
transliteration_iast: apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣu juhvati sarve py 'ete yajña-vido yajña-kṣapita-kalmaṣāḥ
english_translation: Others, controlling their diet, sacrifice their worldly life to the spiritual fire. All understand the principle of sacrifice, and by it their sins are washed away.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम्। नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतो़ऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम।।
transliteration_iast: yajña-śhiṣhṭāmṛita-bhujo yānti brahma sanātanam nāyaṁ loko ’styayajñasya kuto ’nyaḥ kuru-sattama
english_translation: Tasting the nectar of immortality, as the reward of sacrifice, they reach the Eternal. This world is not for those who refuse to sacrifice; nor is the other world.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे। कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे।।
transliteration_iast: evaṁ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe karma-jān viddhi tān sarvān evaṁ jñātvā vimokṣhyase
english_translation: In this way, other sacrifices may also be undertaken for the sake of the Spirit. Know that they all depend on action. Knowing this, you will be free.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप। सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते।।
transliteration_iast: śhreyān dravya-mayād yajñāj jñāna-yajñaḥ parantapa sarvaṁ karmākhilaṁ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate
english_translation: The sacrifice of wisdom is superior to any material sacrifice, for, O Arjuna, the pinnacle of action is always realization.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया। उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः।।
transliteration_iast: tad viddhi praṇipātena paripraśhnena sevayā upadekṣhyanti te jñānaṁ jñāninas tattva-darśhinaḥ
english_translation: This you shall learn by prostrating yourself at the master's feet, questioning them, and serving them. The wise who have realized the truth will teach you wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव। येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि।।
transliteration_iast: yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṁ yāsyasi pāṇḍava yena bhūtānyaśheṣheṇa drakṣhyasyātmanyatho mayi
english_translation: Having known That, you shall never again be confounded; and, O Arjuna, by the power of that wisdom, you shall see all these people as if they were your own Self, and therefore as Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः। सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि।।
transliteration_iast: api ched asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛit-tamaḥ sarvaṁ jñāna-plavenaiva vṛijinaṁ santariṣhyasi
english_translation: Even if you are the greatest of sinners, you will cross over all sin by the ferryboat of wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन। ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा।।
transliteration_iast: yathaidhānsi samiddho ’gnir bhasma-sāt kurute ’rjuna jñānāgniḥ sarva-karmāṇi bhasma-sāt kurute tathā
english_translation: As the kindled fire consumes the fuel, so, O Arjuna, the embers of action are burnt to ashes in the flame of wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते। तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति।।
transliteration_iast: na hi jñānena sadṛiśhaṁ pavitramiha vidyate tatsvayaṁ yogasansiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati
english_translation: There is nothing in the world so purifying as wisdom; and he who is a perfect saint finds that at last within himself.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः। ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: śhraddhāvān labhate jñānaṁ tat-paraḥ sanyatendriyaḥ jñānaṁ labdhvā parāṁ śhāntim achireṇādhigachchhati
english_translation: He who is full of faith attains wisdom, and he who can control his senses, having attained that wisdom, will soon attain Supreme Peace.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति। नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः।।
transliteration_iast: ajñaśh chāśhraddadhānaśh cha sanśhayātmā vinaśhyati nāyaṁ loko ’sti na paro na sukhaṁ sanśhayātmanaḥ
english_translation: But the ignorant man, and he who has no faith, and the skeptic are lost. Neither in this world nor elsewhere is there any happiness in store for him who always doubts.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम्। आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय।।
transliteration_iast: yoga-sannyasta-karmāṇaṁ jñāna-sañchhinna-sanśhayam ātmavantaṁ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
english_translation: But the one who has renounced their actions for meditation, who has cleaved their doubts in two by the sword of wisdom, and who remains always enthroned in their Self, is not bound by their actions.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मादज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनाऽऽत्मनः। छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत।।
transliteration_iast: tasmād ajñāna-sambhūtaṁ hṛit-sthaṁ jñānāsinātmanaḥ chhittvainaṁ sanśhayaṁ yogam ātiṣhṭhottiṣhṭha bhārata
english_translation: Therefore, cleave asunder with the sword of wisdom the doubts of the heart, which your own ignorance has engendered, and follow the path of wisdom and arise!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि। यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्िचतम्।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha sannyāsaṁ karmaṇāṁ kṛiṣhṇa punar yogaṁ cha śhansasi yach chhreya etayor ekaṁ tan me brūhi su-niśhchitam
english_translation: Arjuna said: My Lord! At one moment, You praise renunciation of action; at another, You praise right action. Tell me truly, I pray, which of these is more conducive to my highest welfare?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ। तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha sannyāsaḥ karma-yogaśh cha niḥśhreyasa-karāvubhau tayos tu karma-sannyāsāt karma-yogo viśhiṣhyate
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Both renunciation of action and the path of right action lead to the highest; however, right action is the better of the two.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति। निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: jñeyaḥ sa nitya-sannyāsī yo na dveṣhṭi na kāṅkṣhati nirdvandvo hi mahā-bāho sukhaṁ bandhāt pramuchyate
english_translation: He is a true ascetic who never desires nor dislikes, who is unaffected by the opposites and is easily freed from bondage.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः। एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्।।
transliteration_iast: sānkhya-yogau pṛithag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyag ubhayor vindate phalam
english_translation: Only the unenlightened speak of wisdom and right action as separate; the wise do not. If anyone knows one, they enjoy the fruit of both.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यत्सांख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते। एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।
transliteration_iast: yat sānkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṁ tad yogair api gamyate ekaṁ sānkhyaṁ cha yogaṁ cha yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati
english_translation: The level which is attained through wisdom is also reached through right action. He who perceives that the two are one, knows the truth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः। योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: sannyāsas tu mahā-bāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ yoga-yukto munir brahma na chireṇādhigachchhati
english_translation: Without concentration, O Mighty One, renunciation is difficult. But the sage who is always meditating on the Divine, shall soon attain the Absolute.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः। सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yoga-yukto viśhuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ sarva-bhūtātma-bhūtātmā kurvann api na lipyate
english_translation: He who is spiritual, pure, has overcome his senses and his personal self, and has realized his highest Self as the Self of all—even though he acts, he is not bound by his actions.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नैव किंचित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित्। पश्यन् श्रृणवन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपन् श्वसन्।।
transliteration_iast: naiva kiñchit karomīti yukto manyeta tattva-vit paśhyañ śhṛiṇvan spṛiśhañjighrann aśhnangachchhan svapañśhvasan pralapan visṛijan gṛihṇann unmiṣhan nimiṣhann api indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣhu vartanta iti dhārayan
english_translation: Though the saint sees, hears, touches, smells, eats, moves, sleeps, and breathes, yet he knows the truth and knows that it is not he who acts.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्।।
transliteration_iast: pralapan visṛjan gṛhṇann unmiṣan nimiṣann api indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
english_translation: Though he talks, gives, receives, opens his eyes, and shuts them, he still knows that his senses are merely disporting themselves among the objects of perception.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः। लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा।।
transliteration_iast: brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ lipyate na sa pāpena padma-patram ivāmbhasā
english_translation: He who dedicates his actions to the Spirit, without any personal attachment to them, is no more tainted by sin than the water lily is wetted by water.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि। योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मशुद्धये।।
transliteration_iast: kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalair indriyair api yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṁ tyaktvātma-śhuddhaye
english_translation: The sage performs his action dispassionately, using his body, mind, intellect, and even his senses, always as a means for purification.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम्। अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yuktaḥ karma-phalaṁ tyaktvā śhāntim āpnoti naiṣhṭhikīm ayuktaḥ kāma-kāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
english_translation: Having abandoned the fruit of action, he wins eternal peace. Others, unacquainted with spirituality, led by desire and clinging to the benefit they think will follow their actions, become entangled in them.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी। नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-karmāṇi manasā sannyasyāste sukhaṁ vaśhī nava-dvāre pure dehī naiva kurvan na kārayan
english_translation: Mentally renouncing all actions, the self-controlled soul enjoys bliss in this body, the city of the nine gates, neither doing anything themselves nor causing anything to be done.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः। न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते।।
transliteration_iast: na kartṛitvaṁ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛijati prabhuḥ na karma-phala-saṅyogaṁ svabhāvas tu pravartate
english_translation: The Lord of this universe has not ordained activity, nor any incentive thereto, nor any relation between an act and its consequences; all this is the work of Nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः। अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः।।
transliteration_iast: nādatte kasyachit pāpaṁ na chaiva sukṛitaṁ vibhuḥ ajñānenāvṛitaṁ jñānaṁ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
english_translation: The Lord does not accept responsibility for any person's sin or merit; they are deluded, for wisdom is submerged in ignorance within them.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः। तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्।।
transliteration_iast: jñānena tu tad ajñānaṁ yeṣhāṁ nāśhitam ātmanaḥ teṣhām āditya-vaj jñānaṁ prakāśhayati tat param
english_translation: Surely, wisdom is like the sun, revealing the supreme truth to those whose ignorance has been dispelled by the wisdom of the Self.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः। गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः।।
transliteration_iast: tad-buddhayas tad-ātmānas tan-niṣhṭhās tat-parāyaṇāḥ gachchhantyapunar-āvṛittiṁ jñāna-nirdhūta-kalmaṣhāḥ
english_translation: Meditating on the divine, having faith in the divine, concentrating on the divine, and losing themselves in the divine, their sins dissolve in wisdom, and they go from whence there is no return.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि। शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः।।
transliteration_iast: vidyā-vinaya-sampanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini śhuni chaiva śhva-pāke cha paṇḍitāḥ sama-darśhinaḥ
english_translation: Sages look upon all equally, whether they be a minister of learning and humility, an infidel, a cow, an elephant, or a dog.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः। निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः।।
transliteration_iast: ihaiva tair jitaḥ sargo yeṣhāṁ sāmye sthitaṁ manaḥ nirdoṣhaṁ hi samaṁ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
english_translation: Even in this world, those whose minds remain always balanced, fixed on the Supreme, conquer their earthly life; for the Supreme has neither blemish nor bias.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम्। स्थिरबुद्धिरसम्मूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः।।
transliteration_iast: na prahṛiṣhyet priyaṁ prāpya nodvijet prāpya chāpriyam sthira-buddhir asammūḍho brahma-vid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ
english_translation: He who knows and lives in the Absolute remains unmoved and unperturbed; he is not elated by pleasure nor depressed by pain.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत्सुखम्। स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते।।
transliteration_iast: bāhya-sparśheṣhvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yat sukham sa brahma-yoga-yuktātmā sukham akṣhayam aśhnute
english_translation: He finds happiness in his own Self and enjoys eternal bliss, whose heart does not yearn for the contacts of the earth and whose Self is one with the Everlasting.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते। आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः।।
transliteration_iast: ye hi sansparśha-jā bhogā duḥkha-yonaya eva te ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣhu ramate budhaḥ
english_translation: The joys that spring from external associations bring pain; they have their beginnings and their endings. The wise person does not rejoice in them.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात्। कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः।।
transliteration_iast: śhaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṁ prāk śharīra-vimokṣhaṇāt kāma-krodhodbhavaṁ vegaṁ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
english_translation: He who, before leaving his body, learns to overcome the promptings of desire and anger, is a saint and is happy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः। स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: yo 'ntaḥ-sukho 'ntar-ārāmas tathāntar-jyotir eva yaḥ sa yogī brahma-nirvāṇaṁ brahma-bhūto 'dhigachchhati
english_translation: He who is happy within himself and has found its peace, and in whom the inner light shines, that sage attains eternal bliss and becomes one with the spirit.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः। छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः।।
transliteration_iast: labhante brahma-nirvāṇam ṛiṣhayaḥ kṣhīṇa-kalmaṣhāḥ chhinna-dvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ
english_translation: Sages whose sins have been washed away, whose sense of separateness has dissipated, who have subdued themselves, and seek only the welfare of all, come to the Eternal Spirit.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम्। अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्।।
transliteration_iast: kāma-krodha-viyuktānāṁ yatīnāṁ yata-chetasām abhito brahma-nirvāṇaṁ vartate viditātmanām
english_translation: Saints who know themselves, who control their minds, and feel neither desire nor anger, find eternal bliss everywhere.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः। प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ।।
transliteration_iast: sparśhān kṛitvā bahir bāhyānśh chakṣhuśh chaivāntare bhruvoḥ prāṇāpānau samau kṛitvā nāsābhyantara-chāriṇau yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir mokṣha-parāyaṇaḥ vigatechchhā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
english_translation: Excluding external objects, with his gaze fixed between the eyebrows, and the inward and outward breathings passing equally through his nostrils;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः। विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः।।
transliteration_iast: yatendriya-mano-buddhir munir mokṣa-parāyaṇaḥ vigatecchā-bhaya-krodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
english_translation: Governing sense, mind, and intellect, intent on liberation, free from desire, fear, and anger, the sage is eternally free.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्। सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: bhoktāraṁ yajña-tapasāṁ sarva-loka-maheśhvaram suhṛidaṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ jñātvā māṁ śhāntim ṛichchhati
english_translation: Knowing Me as the One who gladly receives all offerings of austerity and sacrifice, as the Mighty Ruler of all the Worlds and the Friend of all beings, he passes to Eternal Peace.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः। स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha anāśhritaḥ karma-phalaṁ kāryaṁ karma karoti yaḥ sa sannyāsī cha yogī cha na niragnir na chākriyaḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: He who acts out of duty, without considering the consequences, is truly spiritual and a true ascetic; not he who merely observes rituals or shuns all action.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव। न ह्यसंन्यस्तसङ्कल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन।।
transliteration_iast: yaṁ sannyāsam iti prāhur yogaṁ taṁ viddhi pāṇḍava na hyasannyasta-saṅkalpo yogī bhavati kaśhchana
english_translation: O Arjuna, renunciation is indeed what is known as right action. No one can become spiritually enlightened who has not renounced all desires.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते। योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: ārurukṣhor muner yogaṁ karma kāraṇam uchyate yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śhamaḥ kāraṇam uchyate
english_translation: For the sage who seeks the heights of spiritual meditation, practice is the only method, and when they have attained it, they must maintain themselves there through continual self-control.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते। सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yadā hi nendriyārtheṣhu na karmasv-anuṣhajjate sarva-saṅkalpa-sannyāsī yogārūḍhas tadochyate
english_translation: When a man renounces even the thought of initiating action, and is not interested in sense objects or any results that may flow from his acts, then he truly understands spirituality.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः।।
transliteration_iast: uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet ātmaiva hyātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
english_translation: Let him seek liberation with the help of his Highest Self, and never disgrace his own Self. For that Self is his only friend; yet it can also be his enemy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः। अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्।।
transliteration_iast: bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ anātmanas tu śhatrutve vartetātmaiva śhatru-vat
english_translation: To one who has conquered their lower nature with its help, the Self is a friend; but to one who has not done so, it is an enemy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः। शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः।।
transliteration_iast: jitātmanaḥ praśhāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
english_translation: The Self of one who is self-controlled and has attained peace is equally unmoved by heat or cold, pleasure or pain, honor or dishonor.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः। युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।।
transliteration_iast: jñāna-vijñāna-tṛiptātmā kūṭa-stho vijitendriyaḥ yukta ityuchyate yogī sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ
english_translation: He who desires nothing but wisdom and spiritual insight, who has conquered his senses, and who looks upon a lump of earth, a stone, and fine gold with the same eye, is a real saint.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु। साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते।।
transliteration_iast: suhṛin-mitrāryudāsīna-madhyastha-dveṣhya-bandhuṣhu sādhuṣhvapi cha pāpeṣhu sama-buddhir viśhiṣhyate
english_translation: He looks impartially on all—lovers, friends, or foes; indifferent, hostile, alien, or relative; virtuous or sinful.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः। एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः।।
transliteration_iast: yogī yuñjīta satatam ātmānaṁ rahasi sthitaḥ ekākī yata-chittātmā nirāśhīr aparigrahaḥ
english_translation: Let the student of spirituality try unceasingly to concentrate his mind; let him live in seclusion, absolutely alone, with his mind and personality controlled, free from desire and without possessions.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः। नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhuchau deśhe pratiṣhṭhāpya sthiram āsanam ātmanaḥ nātyuchchhritaṁ nāti-nīchaṁ chailājina-kuśhottaram
english_translation: Having chosen a holy place, let him sit in a firm posture on a seat that is neither too high nor too low, and cover it with a grass mat, a deer skin, and a cloth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः। उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये।।
transliteration_iast: tatraikāgraṁ manaḥ kṛitvā yata-chittendriya-kriyaḥ upaviśhyāsane yuñjyād yogam ātma-viśhuddhaye
english_translation: Seated thus, with his mind concentrated, his functions controlled, and his senses governed, let him practice meditation for the purification of his lower nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः। संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्।।
transliteration_iast: samaṁ kāya-śhiro-grīvaṁ dhārayann achalaṁ sthiraḥ samprekṣhya nāsikāgraṁ svaṁ diśhaśh chānavalokayan
english_translation: Let him hold his body, head, and neck erect, motionless and steady; let him look fixedly at the tip of his nose, turning neither to the right nor to the left.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः। मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः।।
transliteration_iast: praśhāntātmā vigata-bhīr brahmachāri-vrate sthitaḥ manaḥ sanyamya mach-chitto yukta āsīta mat-paraḥ
english_translation: With peace in his heart and no fear, observing the vow of celibacy, with his mind controlled and fixed on Me, let the student lose himself in contemplation of Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी नियतमानसः। शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī niyata-mānasaḥ śhantiṁ nirvāṇa-paramāṁ mat-sansthām adhigachchhati
english_translation: Thus, keeping his mind always in communion with Me and subduing his thoughts, he shall attain that Peace which is Mine and will lead him to liberation at last.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः। न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन।।
transliteration_iast: nātyaśhnatastu yogo ’sti na chaikāntam anaśhnataḥ na chāti-svapna-śhīlasya jāgrato naiva chārjuna
english_translation: Meditation is not for him who eats too much, nor for him who eats not at all; not for him who is overly addicted to sleep, nor for him who is always awake.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु। युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा।।
transliteration_iast: yuktāhāra-vihārasya yukta-cheṣhṭasya karmasu yukta-svapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkha-hā
english_translation: But for him who regulates his food and recreation, who is balanced in action, in sleep, and in waking, it shall dispel all unhappiness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते। निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा।।
transliteration_iast: yadā viniyataṁ chittam ātmanyevāvatiṣhṭhate niḥspṛihaḥ sarva-kāmebhyo yukta ityuchyate tadā
english_translation: When the mind is completely controlled, centered in the Self, and free from all earthly desires, then the man is truly spiritual.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता। योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः।।
transliteration_iast: yathā dīpo nivāta-stho neṅgate sopamā smṛitā yogino yata-chittasya yuñjato yogam ātmanaḥ
english_translation: The wise man who has conquered his mind and is absorbed in the Self is like a lamp that does not flicker, as it stands sheltered from every wind.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया। यत्र चैवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति।।
transliteration_iast: yatroparamate chittaṁ niruddhaṁ yoga-sevayā yatra chaivātmanātmānaṁ paśhyann ātmani tuṣhyati
english_translation: There, where the whole of nature is seen in the light of the Self, where the person abides within their Self and is satisfied there, their functions restrained by their union with the Divine, the mind finds rest.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम्। वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः।।
transliteration_iast: sukham ātyantikaṁ yat tad buddhi-grāhyam atīndriyam vetti yatra na chaivāyaṁ sthitaśh chalati tattvataḥ
english_translation: When he enjoys the bliss that surpasses the senses and can only be grasped by the pure intellect, when he comes to rest within his highest self, he will never again stray from reality.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः। यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yaṁ labdhvā chāparaṁ lābhaṁ manyate nādhikaṁ tataḥ yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vichālyate
english_translation: Finding That, he will realize that there is no possession so precious. And once established there, no calamity can disturb him.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तं विद्याद् दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम्। स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा।।
transliteration_iast: taṁ vidyād duḥkha-sanyoga-viyogaṁ yogasaṅjñitam sa niśhchayena yoktavyo yogo ’nirviṇṇa-chetasā
english_translation: This inner severance from the affliction of misery is spirituality. It should be practiced with determination and with a heart that refuses to be depressed.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सङ्कल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः। मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः।।
transliteration_iast: saṅkalpa-prabhavān kāmāns tyaktvā sarvān aśheṣhataḥ manasaivendriya-grāmaṁ viniyamya samantataḥ
english_translation: Renouncing every desire that can be imagined, controlling the senses at every point through the power of the mind;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: शनैः शनैरुपरमेद् बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया। आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किञ्चिदपि चिन्तयेत्।।
transliteration_iast: śhanaiḥ śhanair uparamed buddhyā dhṛiti-gṛihītayā ātma-sansthaṁ manaḥ kṛitvā na kiñchid api chintayet
english_translation: Little by little, with the help of his reason controlled by fortitude, let him attain peace; and, fixing his mind on the Self, let him not think of anything else.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम्। ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्।।
transliteration_iast: yato yato niśhcharati manaśh chañchalam asthiram tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmanyeva vaśhaṁ nayet
english_translation: When the volatile and wavering mind wanders, let him restrain it and bring it back to its allegiance to the Self.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम्। उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्।।
transliteration_iast: praśhānta-manasaṁ hyenaṁ yoginaṁ sukham uttamam upaiti śhānta-rajasaṁ brahma-bhūtam akalmaṣham
english_translation: Supreme bliss is the lot of the sage whose mind attains peace, whose passions subside, who is without sin, and who becomes one with the Absolute.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: युञ्जन्नेवं सदाऽऽत्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः। सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते।।
transliteration_iast: yuñjann evaṁ sadātmānaṁ yogī vigata-kalmaṣhaḥ sukhena brahma-sansparśham atyantaṁ sukham aśhnute
english_translation: Thus, free from sin, abiding always in the Eternal, the saint enjoys, without effort, the bliss that flows from the realization of the Infinite.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि। ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-bhūta-stham ātmānaṁ sarva-bhūtāni chātmani īkṣhate yoga-yuktātmā sarvatra sama-darśhanaḥ
english_translation: He who experiences the unity of life sees his own Self in all beings, and all beings in his own Self, and looks upon everything with an impartial eye.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति। तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति।।
transliteration_iast: yo māṁ paśhyati sarvatra sarvaṁ cha mayi paśhyati tasyāhaṁ na praṇaśhyāmi sa cha me na praṇaśhyati
english_translation: He who sees Me in everything and everything in Me, I shall never forsake him, nor shall he lose Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः। सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-bhūta-sthitaṁ yo māṁ bhajatyekatvam āsthitaḥ sarvathā vartamāno ’pi sa yogī mayi vartate
english_translation: The sage who realizes the unity of life and who worships Me in all beings, lives in Me, no matter what their lot may be.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन। सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं सः योगी परमो मतः।।
transliteration_iast: ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṁ paśhyati yo ’rjuna sukhaṁ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṁ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
english_translation: O Arjuna! He is the perfect saint who, having been taught by the likeness within himself, sees the same Self everywhere, regardless of whether the outer form be pleasurable or painful.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन। एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात् स्थितिं स्थिराम्।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha yo ’yaṁ yogas tvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana etasyāhaṁ na paśhyāmi chañchalatvāt sthitiṁ sthirām
english_translation: Arjuna said: I do not see how I can attain this state of equanimity which You have revealed, owing to the restlessness of my mind.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम्। तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्।।
transliteration_iast: chañchalaṁ hi manaḥ kṛiṣhṇa pramāthi balavad dṛiḍham tasyāhaṁ nigrahaṁ manye vāyor iva su-duṣhkaram
english_translation: My Lord! Verily, the mind is fickle and turbulent, obstinate, and strong; indeed, it is extremely difficult to control, like the wind.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलं। अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha asanśhayaṁ mahā-bāho mano durnigrahaṁ chalam abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa cha gṛihyate
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Doubtless, O Mighty One, the mind is fickle and exceedingly difficult to restrain; however, O Son of Kunti, with practice and renunciation, it can be done.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः। वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः।।
transliteration_iast: asaṅyatātmanā yogo duṣhprāpa iti me matiḥ vaśhyātmanā tu yatatā śhakyo ’vāptum upāyataḥ
english_translation: It is not possible to attain Self-Realization unless one knows how to control oneself; however, for one who, striving by the proper means, learns such control, it is possible.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः। अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha ayatiḥ śhraddhayopeto yogāch chalita-mānasaḥ aprāpya yoga-sansiddhiṁ kāṅ gatiṁ kṛiṣhṇa gachchhati
english_translation: Arjuna asked: What of him who fails to control himself, whose mind falls from spiritual contemplation, yet retains his faith and does not attain perfection?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति। अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि।।
transliteration_iast: kachchin nobhaya-vibhraṣhṭaśh chhinnābhram iva naśhyati apratiṣhṭho mahā-bāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
english_translation: Having failed in both, my Lord, is he without hope, like a riven cloud with no support, lost on the spiritual path?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः। त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते।।
transliteration_iast: etan me sanśhayaṁ kṛiṣhṇa chhettum arhasyaśheṣhataḥ tvad-anyaḥ sanśhayasyāsya chhettā na hyupapadyate
english_translation: My Lord! You are worthy to solve this doubt once and for all; there is no one else competent to do so, save Yourself.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते। नहि कल्याणकृत्कश्िचद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśhas tasya vidyate na hi kalyāṇa-kṛit kaśhchid durgatiṁ tāta gachchhati
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: My beloved child! There is no destruction for him, either in this world or the next. No evil fate awaits him who treads the path of righteousness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः। शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते।।
transliteration_iast: prāpya puṇya-kṛitāṁ lokān uṣhitvā śhāśhvatīḥ samāḥ śhuchīnāṁ śhrīmatāṁ gehe yoga-bhraṣhṭo’bhijāyate
english_translation: Having reached the worlds where the righteous dwell, and having remained there for many years, he who has strayed from the path of spirituality will be born again into the family of the pure, benevolent, and prosperous.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्। एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्।।
transliteration_iast: atha vā yoginām eva kule bhavati dhīmatām etad dhi durlabhataraṁ loke janma yad īdṛiśham
english_translation: Or, he may be born in the family of wise sages, though such a birth is indeed very difficult to obtain.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम्। यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन।।
transliteration_iast: tatra taṁ buddhi-sanyogaṁ labhate paurva-dehikam yatate cha tato bhūyaḥ sansiddhau kuru-nandana
english_translation: Then, the experience acquired in his former life will revive, and with it, he will more eagerly strive for perfection than before.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः। जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते।।
transliteration_iast: pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśho ’pi saḥ jijñāsur api yogasya śhabda-brahmātivartate
english_translation: Unconsciously, he will return to the practices of his old life; thus, one who strives to attain spiritual consciousness is certainly superior to one who merely talks about it.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः। अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्।।
transliteration_iast: prayatnād yatamānas tu yogī sanśhuddha-kilbiṣhaḥ aneka-janma-sansiddhas tato yāti parāṁ gatim
english_translation: Then, after many lives of earnest striving and absolution of sins, the student of spirituality attains perfection and reaches the Supreme.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः। कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन।।
transliteration_iast: tapasvibhyo ’dhiko yogī jñānibhyo ’pi mato ’dhikaḥ karmibhyaśh chādhiko yogī tasmād yogī bhavārjuna
english_translation: The wise person is superior to the ascetic, the scholar, and the man of action; therefore, be thou a wise person, O Arjuna!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना। श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः।।
transliteration_iast: yoginām api sarveṣhāṁ mad-gatenāntar-ātmanā śhraddhāvān bhajate yo māṁ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
english_translation: I look upon him as the best of mystics, who, full of faith, worships Me and abides in Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः। असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī bhagavān uvācha mayyāsakta-manāḥ pārtha yogaṁ yuñjan mad-āśhrayaḥ asanśhayaṁ samagraṁ māṁ yathā jñāsyasi tach chhṛiṇu
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna said: Listen, O Arjuna! I will tell you how you can know Me in my full perfection. Practice meditation with your mind devoted to Me and take Me as your refuge.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः। यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते।।
transliteration_iast: jñānaṁ te ’haṁ sa-vijñānam idaṁ vakṣhyāmyaśheṣhataḥ yaj jñātvā neha bhūyo ’nyaj jñātavyam-avaśhiṣhyate
english_translation: I will reveal this knowledge to you and how it can be realized; once accomplished, there is nothing else worth having in this life.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.
