transliteration_iast: aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekādbhuta-darśhanam aneka-divyābharaṇaṁ divyānekodyatāyudham
english_translation: There were countless eyes, mouths, and innumerable mystic forms, with shining ornaments and flaming celestial weapons.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्। सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्।।
transliteration_iast: divya-mālyāmbara-dharaṁ divya-gandhānulepanam sarvāśhcharya-mayaṁ devam anantaṁ viśhvato-mukham
english_translation: Crowned with heavenly garlands, clothed in shining garments, anointed with divine unguents, He showed Himself as the Resplendent One, Marvelous, Boundless, and Omnipresent.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता। यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः।।
transliteration_iast: divi sūrya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā yadi bhāḥ sadṛiśhī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ
english_translation: Could a thousand suns blaze forth together, it would be but a faint reflection of the radiance of the Lord God.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा। अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा।।
transliteration_iast: tatraika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ pravibhaktam anekadhā apaśhyad deva-devasya śharīre pāṇḍavas tadā
english_translation: In that vision, Arjuna saw the universe, with its manifold shapes, all embraced in one, its Supreme Lord.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः। प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत।।
transliteration_iast: tataḥ sa vismayāviṣhṭo hṛiṣhṭa-romā dhanañjayaḥ praṇamya śhirasā devaṁ kṛitāñjalir abhāṣhata
english_translation: Then, Arjuna, filled with awe, his hair standing on end, bowing his head, and clasping his hands in reverence, spoke to the Lord:
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्। ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha paśhyāmi devāns tava deva dehe sarvāns tathā bhūta-viśheṣha-saṅghān brahmāṇam īśhaṁ kamalāsana-stham ṛiṣhīnśh cha sarvān uragānśh cha divyān
english_translation: Arjuna said: O Almighty God! I see in You the powers of Nature, the various creatures of the world, the Progenitor on His lotus throne, the Sages, and the shining angels.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्। नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप।।
transliteration_iast: aneka-bāhūdara-vaktra-netraṁ paśhyāmi tvāṁ sarvato ’nanta-rūpam nāntaṁ na madhyaṁ na punas tavādiṁ paśhyāmi viśhveśhvara viśhva-rūpa
english_translation: I see You, infinite in form, with faces, eyes, and limbs everywhere; with no beginning, middle, or end. O You, Lord of the Universe, whose form is universal!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च तेजोराशिं सर्वतोदीप्तिमन्तम्। पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ता द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्।।
transliteration_iast: kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ chakriṇaṁ cha tejo-rāśhiṁ sarvato dīptimantam paśhyāmi tvāṁ durnirīkṣhyaṁ samantād dīptānalārka-dyutim aprameyam
english_translation: I see you with the crown, the scepter, and the discus; a blaze of splendor. Scarcely can I gaze upon you, so radiant you are, glowing like a blazing fire, brilliant as the sun, immeasurable.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्। त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे।।
transliteration_iast: tvam akṣharaṁ paramaṁ veditavyaṁ tvam asya viśhvasya paraṁ nidhānam tvam avyayaḥ śhāśhvata-dharma-goptā sanātanas tvaṁ puruṣho mato me
english_translation: You are imperishable, the only one worthy of being known, the priceless treasure-house of the universe, the immortal guardian of eternal life, and the everlasting spirit.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्। पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रम् स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्।।
transliteration_iast: स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् || 19||
english_translation: Without beginning, without middle, and without end, infinite in power, with arms all-embracing, the sun and moon as Your eyes, Your face beaming with the fire of sacrifice, flooding the whole universe with light.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः। दृष्ट्वाऽद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्।।
transliteration_iast: dyāv ā-pṛithivyor idam antaraṁ hi vyāptaṁ tvayaikena diśhaśh cha sarvāḥ dṛiṣhṭvādbhutaṁ rūpam ugraṁ tavedaṁ loka-trayaṁ pravyathitaṁ mahātman
english_translation: Alone, you fill all the quarters of the sky, earth, and heaven, and the regions between. O Almighty Lord! Seeing your marvelous and awe-inspiring form, the spheres tremble with fear.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अमी हि त्वां सुरसङ्घाः विशन्ति केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति। स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसङ्घाः स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः।।
transliteration_iast: amī hi tvāṁ sura-saṅghā viśhanti kechid bhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛiṇanti svastīty uktvā maharṣhi-siddha-saṅghāḥ stuvanti tvāṁ stutibhiḥ puṣhkalābhiḥ
english_translation: The troops of celestial beings enter into You, some invoking You in fear, with folded palms; the great seers and adepts sing hymns to Your glory, saying, "All hail!"
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या विश्वेऽश्िवनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च। गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसङ्घा वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे।।
transliteration_iast: rudrādityā vasavo ye cha sādhyā viśhve ’śhvinau marutaśh choṣhmapāśh cha gandharva-yakṣhāsura-siddha-saṅghā vīkṣhante tvāṁ vismitāśh chaiva sarve
english_translation: The vital forces, major stars, fire, earth, air, sky, sun, heaven, moon, and planets; the angels, guardians of the universe, divine healers, winds, fathers, heavenly singers, and hosts of mammon-worshippers, demons, and saints are all amazed.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम्। बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाऽहम्।।
transliteration_iast: rūpaṁ mahat te bahu-vaktra-netraṁ mahā-bāho bahu-bāhūru-pādam bahūdaraṁ bahu-danṣhṭrā-karālaṁ dṛiṣhṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitās tathāham
english_translation: Seeing Thy stupendous Form, O Most Mighty One, with its myriad faces, its innumerable eyes, limbs, and terrible jaws, I myself and all the worlds are overwhelmed with awe.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्। दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो।।
transliteration_iast: nabhaḥ-spṛiśhaṁ dīptam aneka-varṇaṁ vyāttānanaṁ dīpta-viśhāla-netram dṛiṣhṭvā hi tvāṁ pravyathitāntar-ātmā dhṛitiṁ na vindāmi śhamaṁ cha viṣhṇo
english_translation: When I see You, touching the heavens, glowing with color, with open mouth and wide, fiery eyes, I am terrified. O my Lord! My courage and peace of mind abandon me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि। दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास।।
transliteration_iast: danṣhṭrā-karālāni cha te mukhāni dṛiṣhṭvaiva kālānala-sannibhāni diśho na jāne na labhe cha śharma prasīda deveśha jagan-nivāsa
english_translation: When I see Thy mouths with their fearful jaws, like glowing fires at the dissolution of creation, I lose all sense of place and find no rest. Be merciful, O Lord, in whom this universe abides!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसङ्घैः। भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथाऽसौ सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः।।
transliteration_iast: amī cha tvāṁ dhṛitarāśhtrasya putrāḥ sarve sahaivāvani-pāla-saṅghaiḥ bhīṣhmo droṇaḥ sūta-putras tathāsau sahāsmadīyair api yodha-mukhyaiḥ vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśhanti danṣhṭrā-karālāni bhayānakāni kechid vilagnā daśhanāntareṣhu sandṛiśhyante chūrṇitair uttamāṅgaiḥ
english_translation: All these sons of Dhritarashtra, along with the hosts of princes, Bheeshma, Drona, and Karna, as well as the other warrior chiefs on our side;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि। केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः।।
transliteration_iast: vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti daṁṣṭrā-karālāni bhayānakāni kecid vilagnā daśanāntareṣu sandṛśyante cūrṇitair uttamāṅgaiḥ
english_translation: 1 See them all rushing headlong into Thy mouths, with terrible tusks, horrible to behold. Some are mangled between Thy jaws, with their heads crushed to atoms.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः समुद्रमेवाभिमुखाः द्रवन्ति। तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति।।
transliteration_iast: yathā nadīnāṁ bahavo ’mbu-vegāḥ samudram evābhimukhā dravanti tathā tavāmī nara-loka-vīrā viśhanti vaktrāṇy abhivijvalanti
english_translation: As rivers in flood surge furiously towards the ocean, so these heroes, the greatest among men, fling themselves into Thy flaming mouths.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः। तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः।।
transliteration_iast: yathā pradīptaṁ jvalanaṁ pataṅgā viśhanti nāśhāya samṛiddha-vegāḥ tathaiva nāśhāya viśhanti lokās tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛiddha-vegāḥ
english_translation: As moths impetuously fly towards the flame, only to be killed, so these men rush into Your mouths to court their own destruction.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ता ल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः। तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो।।
transliteration_iast: lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl lokān samagrān vadanair jvaladbhiḥ tejobhir āpūrya jagat samagraṁ bhāsas tavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣhṇo
english_translation: You seem to swallow up the worlds, lapping them in flame. Your glory fills the universe. Your fierce rays beat down upon it irresistibly.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद। विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्।।
transliteration_iast: ākhyāhi me ko bhavān ugra-rūpo namo ’stu te deva-vara prasīda vijñātum ichchhāmi bhavantam ādyaṁ na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛittim
english_translation: Tell me then, who are You, who wears this dreadful form? I bow before You, O Mighty One! Have mercy, I pray, and let me see You as You were at first. I do not know what Your intentions are.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः। ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha kālo ’smi loka-kṣhaya-kṛit pravṛiddho lokān samāhartum iha pravṛittaḥ ṛite ’pi tvāṁ na bhaviṣhyanti sarve ye ’vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣhu yodhāḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: I have shown myself to you as the Destroyer who lays waste the world and whose purpose is destruction. In spite of your efforts, all these warriors gathered for battle shall not escape death.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्। मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्।।
transliteration_iast: tasmāt tvam uttiṣhṭha yaśho labhasva jitvā śhatrūn bhuṅkṣhva rājyaṁ samṛiddham mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvam eva nimitta-mātraṁ bhava savya-sāchin
english_translation: Then gird up your loins and conquer. Subdue your foes and enjoy the kingdom in prosperity. I have already doomed them. Be thou my instrument, Arjuna!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च कर्णं तथाऽन्यानपि योधवीरान्। मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्।।
transliteration_iast: droṇaṁ cha bhīṣhmaṁ cha jayadrathaṁ cha karṇaṁ tathānyān api yodha-vīrān mayā hatāṁs tvaṁ jahi mā vyathiṣhṭhā yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān
english_translation: Drona, Bheeshma, Jayadratha, Karna, and other brave warriors - I have condemned them all. Destroy them; fight without fear. Your foes shall be crushed."
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सञ्जय उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी। नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य।।
transliteration_iast: sañjaya uvācha etach chhrutvā vachanaṁ keśhavasya kṛitāñjalir vepamānaḥ kirīṭī namaskṛitvā bhūya evāha kṛiṣhṇaṁ sa-gadgadaṁ bhīta-bhītaḥ praṇamya
english_translation: Sanjaya continued: "Having heard these words from the Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince Arjuna, with folded hands trembling, prostrated himself and with a choked voice, bowing down again and again, and overwhelmed with awe, once more addressed the Lord.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या जगत् प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च। रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसङ्घाः।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha sthāne hṛiṣhīkeśha tava prakīrtyā jagat prahṛiṣhyaty anurajyate cha rakṣhānsi bhītāni diśho dravanti sarve namasyanti cha siddha-saṅghāḥ
english_translation: Arjuna said: My Lord! It is natural for the world to revel and rejoice when singing praises of Your glory; the demons fly in fear and the saints offer You their salutations.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन् गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे। अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्।।
transliteration_iast: kasmāch cha te na nameran mahātman garīyase brahmaṇo ’py ādi-kartre ananta deveśha jagan-nivāsa tvam akṣharaṁ sad-asat tat paraṁ yat
english_translation: How else should they do? O Supreme Self, greater than the powers of creation, the first cause, infinite, the Lord of Lords, the home of the universe, imperishable, being and non-being, yet transcending both.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम्। वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप।।
transliteration_iast: tvam ādi-devaḥ puruṣhaḥ purāṇas tvam asya viśhvasya paraṁ nidhānam vettāsi vedyaṁ cha paraṁ cha dhāma tvayā tataṁ viśhvam ananta-rūpa
english_translation: You are the Primal God, the Ancient One, the Supreme Abode of this universe, the Knower, the Knowledge, and the Final Home. You fill everything. Your form is infinite.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च। नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते।।
transliteration_iast: vāyur yamo ’gnir varuṇaḥ śhaśhāṅkaḥ prajāpatis tvaṁ prapitāmahaśh cha namo namas te ’stu sahasra-kṛitvaḥ punaśh cha bhūyo ’pi namo namas te
english_translation: You are the wind, you are death, you are the fire, the water, the moon, the father, and the grandfather. Honor and glory to you a thousand and a thousand times! Again and again, salutations to you, O my Lord!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व। अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः।।
transliteration_iast: namaḥ purastād atha pṛiṣhṭhatas te namo ’stu te sarvata eva sarva ananta-vīryāmita-vikramas tvaṁ sarvaṁ samāpnoṣhi tato ’si sarvaḥ
english_translation: Salutations to Thee in front and on all sides, Thou who encompasseth me round about. Thy power is infinite; Thy majesty immeasurable; Thou upholdest all things; indeed, Thou Thyself art All.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति। अजानता महिमानं तवेदं मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि।।
transliteration_iast: sakheti matvā prasabhaṁ yad uktaṁ he kṛiṣhṇa he yādava he sakheti ajānatā mahimānaṁ tavedaṁ mayā pramādāt praṇayena vāpi
english_translation: Whatever I have said to you in rashness, taking you only as a friend and addressing you as “O Krishna! O Yadava! O Friend!” in thoughtless familiarity, without understanding your greatness;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु। एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्।।
transliteration_iast: yach chāvahāsārtham asat-kṛito ’si vihāra-śhayyāsana-bhojaneṣhu eko ’tha vāpy achyuta tat-samakṣhaṁ tat kṣhāmaye tvām aham aprameyam
english_translation: Whatever insults I have offered to You in jest, in sport, in repose, in conversation, or at a banquet, alone or in a crowd, I ask for Your forgiveness for them all, O You Who are without equal!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान्। न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव।।
transliteration_iast: pitāsi lokasya charācharasya tvam asya pūjyaśh cha gurur garīyān na tvat-samo ’sty abhyadhikaḥ kuto ’nyo loka-traye ’py apratima-prabhāva
english_translation: For you are the Father of all things movable and immovable, the Worshipful, the Master of Masters! In all the worlds, there is none equal to you; how then could there be one superior, O you who stand alone, Supreme?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्। पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्।।
transliteration_iast: tasmāt praṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṁ prasādaye tvām aham īśham īḍyam piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
english_translation: Therefore, I prostrate myself before You, O Lord! Most Adorable! I salute You, and I ask for Your blessing. Only You can be trusted to bear with me, like a father to a son, like a friend to a friend, and like a lover to his beloved.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे। तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास।।
transliteration_iast: adṛiṣhṭa-pūrvaṁ hṛiṣhito ’smi dṛiṣhṭvā bhayena cha pravyathitaṁ mano me tad eva me darśhaya deva rūpaṁ prasīda deveśha jagan-nivāsa
english_translation: I rejoice that I have seen what no man has ever seen before; yet, O Lord! I am overwhelmed with fear. Please take on the form I know. Be merciful, O Lord! You who are the home of the entire universe.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्त मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव। तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते।।
transliteration_iast: kirīṭinaṁ gadinaṁ chakra-hastam ichchhāmi tvāṁ draṣhṭum ahaṁ tathaiva tenaiva rūpeṇa chatur-bhujena sahasra-bāho bhava viśhva-mūrte
english_translation: I long to see Thee as Thou wert before, with the crown, the scepter, and the discus in Thy hands; in Thy other form, with Thy four hands, O Thou whose arms are countless and whose forms are infinite.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात्। तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṁ rūpaṁ paraṁ darśhitam ātma-yogāt tejo-mayaṁ viśhvam anantam ādyaṁ yan me tvad anyena na dṛiṣhṭa-pūrvam
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: My beloved friend! It is only through My grace and power that you have been able to see this vision of splendour, the Universal, the Infinite, the Original. Never has it been seen by anyone else.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः। एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर।।
transliteration_iast: na veda-yajñādhyayanair na dānair na cha kriyābhir na tapobhir ugraiḥ evaṁ-rūpaḥ śhakya ahaṁ nṛi-loke draṣhṭuṁ tvad anyena kuru-pravīra
english_translation: It is not possible for man on earth to see what thou hast seen, O thou foremost hero of the Kuru-clan, through study of the scriptures, sacrifice or gift, ritual or rigorous austerity!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्। व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य।।
transliteration_iast: mā te vyathā mā cha vimūḍha-bhāvo dṛiṣhṭvā rūpaṁ ghoram īdṛiṅ mamedam vyapeta-bhīḥ prīta-manāḥ punas tvaṁ tad eva me rūpam idaṁ prapaśhya
english_translation: Do not be afraid or confused by the terrible vision. Put away your fear and, with a joyful mind, see Me again in My usual form.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सञ्जय उवाच इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः। आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा।।
transliteration_iast: sañjaya uvācha ity arjunaṁ vāsudevas tathoktvā svakaṁ rūpaṁ darśhayām āsa bhūyaḥ āśhvāsayām āsa cha bhītam enaṁ bhūtvā punaḥ saumya-vapur mahātmā
english_translation: Sanjaya continued: "Having thus spoken to Arjuna, Lord Shri Krishna showed Himself again in His accustomed form; and the Mighty Lord, in gentle tones, softly consoled him who had recently trembled with fear.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तवसौम्यं जनार्दन। इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha dṛiṣhṭvedaṁ mānuṣhaṁ rūpaṁ tava saumyaṁ janārdana idānīm asmi saṁvṛittaḥ sa-chetāḥ prakṛitiṁ gataḥ
english_translation: Arjuna said: Seeing You in Your gentle human form, my Lord, I am myself again, calm once more.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम। देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha su-durdarśham idaṁ rūpaṁ dṛiṣhṭavān asi yan mama devā apy asya rūpasya nityaṁ darśhana-kāṅkṣhiṇaḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: It is difficult to see the vision of Me that thou hast seen. Even the most powerful have longed for it in vain.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया। शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा।।
transliteration_iast: nāhaṁ vedair na tapasā na dānena na chejyayā śhakya evaṁ-vidho draṣhṭuṁ dṛiṣhṭavān asi māṁ yathā
english_translation: It is not possible to see Me as you have done through studying the scriptures, performing austerities, giving gifts, or making sacrifices.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्यमहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन। ज्ञातुं दृष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप।।
transliteration_iast: bhaktyā tv ananyayā śhakya aham evaṁ-vidho ’rjuna jñātuṁ draṣhṭuṁ cha tattvena praveṣhṭuṁ cha parantapa
english_translation: Only through tireless devotion can I be seen and known; only in this way can a person become one with Me, O Arjuna!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः। निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव।।
transliteration_iast: mat-karma-kṛin mat-paramo mad-bhaktaḥ saṅga-varjitaḥ nirvairaḥ sarva-bhūteṣhu yaḥ sa mām eti pāṇḍava
english_translation: He who does every action for My sake, to whom I am the final goal, who loves Me alone and hates no one—O My dearest son, only he can realize Me!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते। येचाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha evaṁ satata-yuktā ye bhaktās tvāṁ paryupāsate ye chāpy akṣharam avyaktaṁ teṣhāṁ ke yoga-vittamāḥ
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, which are the better devotees who worship You: those who try to know You as a Personal God, or those who worship You as Impersonal and Indestructible?"
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते। श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha mayy āveśhya mano ye māṁ nitya-yuktā upāsate śhraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Those who keep their minds fixed on Me, who worship Me always with unwavering faith and concentration, are the very best.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते। सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्।।
transliteration_iast: ye tv akṣharam anirdeśhyam avyaktaṁ paryupāsate sarvatra-gam achintyañcha kūṭa-stham achalandhruvam sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ sarvatra sama-buddhayaḥ te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ
english_translation: Those who worship Me as the Indestructible, the Undefinable, the Omnipresent, the Unthinkable, the Primal, the Immutable, and the Eternal;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः। ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः।।
transliteration_iast: sanniyamyendriya-grāmaṁ sarvatra sama-buddhayaḥ te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarva-bhūta-hite ratāḥ
english_translation: Subduing their senses, viewing all conditions of life with an equal eye, and working for the welfare of all beings, they assuredly come to Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्। अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते।।
transliteration_iast: kleśho ’dhikataras teṣhām avyaktāsakta-chetasām avyaktā hi gatir duḥkhaṁ dehavadbhir avāpyate
english_translation: But they who fix their attention on the Absolute and Impersonal encounter greater hardships, for it is difficult for those who have a body to realize Me as without one.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः। अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते।।
transliteration_iast: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ ananyenaiva yogena māṁ dhyāyanta upāsate
english_translation: Verily, those who surrender their actions to Me, who contemplate Me, worship Me, and meditate on Me alone, with no thought other than Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्। भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्।।
transliteration_iast: teṣhām ahaṁ samuddhartā mṛityu-saṁsāra-sāgarāt bhavāmi na chirāt pārtha mayy āveśhita-chetasām
english_translation: O Arjuna! I rescue them from the ocean of life and death, for their minds are fixed upon Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय। निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः।।
transliteration_iast: mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṁ niveśhaya nivasiṣhyasi mayy eva ata ūrdhvaṁ na sanśhayaḥ
english_translation: Then let your mind cling only to Me, let your intellect abide in Me; and without doubt, you will live hereafter in Me alone.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम्। अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय।।
transliteration_iast: atha chittaṁ samādhātuṁ na śhaknoṣhi mayi sthiram abhyāsa-yogena tato mām ichchhāptuṁ dhanañjaya
english_translation: But if you cannot fix your mind firmly on Me, then, my beloved friend, try to do so through constant practice.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव। मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन् सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि।।
transliteration_iast: abhyāse ’py asamartho ’si mat-karma-paramo bhava mad-artham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi
english_translation: And if you are not strong enough to practice concentration, then devote yourself to My service, do all your acts for My sake, and you will still attain the goal.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः। सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्।।
transliteration_iast: athaitad apy aśhakto ’si kartuṁ mad-yogam āśhritaḥ sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān
english_translation: And if thou art too weak to do even this, then seek refuge in union with Me, and with perfect self-control renounce the fruits of thy actions.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते। ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṁ viśhiṣhyate dhyānāt karma-phala-tyāgas tyāgāch chhāntir anantaram
english_translation: Knowledge is superior to blind action, meditation is superior to knowledge, renunciation of the fruit of action is superior to meditation, and peace follows from renunciation.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च। निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी।।
transliteration_iast: adveṣhṭā sarva-bhūtānāṁ maitraḥ karuṇa eva cha nirmamo nirahankāraḥ sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ kṣhamī
english_translation: He who is incapable of hatred towards any being, who is kind and compassionate, free from selfishness, without pride, equable in pleasure and pain, and forgiving—
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः। मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।
transliteration_iast: santuṣhṭaḥ satataṁ yogī yatātmā dṛiḍha-niśhchayaḥ mayy arpita-mano-buddhir yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
english_translation: Always content, self-centered, self-controlled, resolute, with mind and reason dedicated to Me, such a devotee of Mine is beloved to Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः। हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः।।
transliteration_iast: yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate cha yaḥ harṣhāmarṣha-bhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa cha me priyaḥ
english_translation: He who does not harm the world, and whom the world cannot harm, who is not carried away by any impulse of joy, anger, or fear; such a one is My beloved.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः। सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।
transliteration_iast: anapekṣhaḥ śhuchir dakṣha udāsīno gata-vyathaḥ sarvārambha-parityāgī yo mad-bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
english_translation: He who expects nothing, is pure, watchful, indifferent, unruffled, and renounces all initiative—such a one is My beloved.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति। शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्ितमान्यः स मे प्रियः।।
transliteration_iast: yo na hṛiṣhyati na dveṣhṭi na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati śhubhāśhubha-parityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ
english_translation: He who is beyond joy and hate, who neither laments nor desires, to whom good and evil fortunes are the same, such a one is beloved to Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः। शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः।।
transliteration_iast: samaḥ śhatrau cha mitre cha tathā mānāpamānayoḥ śhītoṣhṇa-sukha-duḥkheṣhu samaḥ saṅga-vivarjitaḥ
english_translation: He to whom friend and foe are alike, who welcomes equally honor and dishonor, heat and cold, pleasure and pain, and who is enamored of nothing—
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येनकेनचित्। अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्ितमान्मे प्रियो नरः।।
transliteration_iast: tulya-nindā-stutir maunī santuṣhṭo yena kenachit aniketaḥ sthira-matir bhaktimān me priyo naraḥ
english_translation: Who is indifferent to praise and censure, enjoys silence, is content with every fate, has no fixed abode, is steadfast in mind, and filled with devotion—such a one is My beloved.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते। श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः।।
transliteration_iast: ye tu dharmyāmṛitam idaṁ yathoktaṁ paryupāsate śhraddadhānā mat-paramā bhaktās te ’tīva me priyāḥ
english_translation: Verily, those who love the spiritual wisdom as I have taught, whose faith never wavers, and who focus their entire being on Me, they are indeed My most beloved.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते। एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha idaṁ śharīraṁ kaunteya kṣhetram ity abhidhīyate etad yo vetti taṁ prāhuḥ kṣhetra-jña iti tad-vidaḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Arjuna! The body of a person is the playground of the Self; and That which knows the activities of Matter, sages call the Self.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत। क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम।।
transliteration_iast: kṣhetra-jñaṁ chāpi māṁ viddhi sarva-kṣhetreṣhu bhārata kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor jñānaṁ yat taj jñānaṁ mataṁ mama
english_translation: I am the omniscient Self that abides in the realm of matter; knowledge of matter and of the all-knowing Self is wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक् च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत्। स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे श्रृणु।।
transliteration_iast: tat kṣhetraṁ yach cha yādṛik cha yad-vikāri yataśh cha yat sa cha yo yat-prabhāvaśh cha tat samāsena me śhṛiṇu
english_translation: What is called Matter, of what it is composed, whence it came, and why it changes, what the Self is, and what its power - this I will now briefly set forth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक्। ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्िचतैः।।
transliteration_iast: ṛiṣhibhir bahudhā gītaṁ chhandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛithak brahma-sūtra-padaiśh chaiva hetumadbhir viniśhchitaiḥ
english_translation: Seers have sung of it in various ways, in many hymns and sacred Vedic songs, weighty in thought and convincing in their arguments.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च। इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः।।
transliteration_iast: mahā-bhūtāny ahankāro buddhir avyaktam eva cha indriyāṇi daśhaikaṁ cha pañcha chendriya-gocharāḥ
english_translation: The five great fundamentals—earth, fire, air, water, and ether—personality, intellect, the mysterious life force, the ten organs of perception and action, the mind, and the five domains of sensation—
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं सङ्घातश्चेतनाधृतिः। एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: ichchhā dveṣhaḥ sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ saṅghātaśh chetanā dhṛitiḥ etat kṣhetraṁ samāsena sa-vikāram udāhṛitam
english_translation: Desire, aversion, pleasure, pain, sympathy, vitality, and the persistent clinging to life—these are, in brief, the constituents of changing matter.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्। आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः।।
transliteration_iast: amānitvam adambhitvam ahinsā kṣhāntir ārjavam āchāryopāsanaṁ śhauchaṁ sthairyam ātma-vinigrahaḥ
english_translation: Humility, sincerity, harmlessness, forgiveness, rectitude, service to the Master, purity, steadfastness, and self-control;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहङ्कार एव च। जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्।।
transliteration_iast: indriyārtheṣhu vairāgyam anahankāra eva cha janma-mṛityu-jarā-vyādhi-duḥkha-doṣhānudarśhanam
english_translation: Renouncing the delights of the senses, being without pride, having a right understanding of the painful problem of birth and death, and of age and sickness;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: असक्ितरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु। नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु।।
transliteration_iast: asaktir anabhiṣhvaṅgaḥ putra-dāra-gṛihādiṣhu nityaṁ cha sama-chittatvam iṣhṭāniṣhṭopapattiṣhu
english_translation: Indifference, non-attachment to sex, progeny, or home, equanimity in both good fortune and bad;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्ितरव्यभिचारिणी। विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि।।
transliteration_iast: mayi chānanya-yogena bhaktir avyabhichāriṇī vivikta-deśha-sevitvam aratir jana-sansadi
english_translation: Unswerving devotion to Me, with concentration on Me and Me alone, a love for solitude, and indifference to social life;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम्। एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोन्यथा।।
transliteration_iast: adhyātma-jñāna-nityatvaṁ tattva-jñānārtha-darśhanam etaj jñānam iti proktam ajñānaṁ yad ato ’nyathā
english_translation: Constant yearning for the knowledge of the Self, and pondering over the lessons of the great Truth—this is wisdom; all else is ignorance.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वाऽमृतमश्नुते। अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: jñeyaṁ yat tat pravakṣhyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛitam aśhnute anādi mat-paraṁ brahma na sat tan nāsad uchyate
english_translation: I will now speak to you of that great truth which one ought to know, since by it one will attain immortal bliss—that which is without beginning, the eternal spirit which dwells in me, neither with form nor without it.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम्। सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति।।
transliteration_iast: sarvataḥ pāṇi-pādaṁ tat sarvato ’kṣhi-śhiro-mukham sarvataḥ śhrutimal loke sarvam āvṛitya tiṣhṭhati
english_translation: Everywhere are Its hands and feet; everywhere It has eyes that see, heads that think, and mouths that speak; everywhere It listens; It dwells in all the worlds and envelops them all.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम्। असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च।।
transliteration_iast: sarvendriya-guṇābhāsaṁ sarvendriya-vivarjitam asaktaṁ sarva-bhṛich chaiva nirguṇaṁ guṇa-bhoktṛi cha
english_translation: Beyond the senses, it yet shines through every sense perception; bound to nothing, it yet sustains everything; unaffected by the qualities, it still enjoys them all.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च। सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्।।
transliteration_iast: bahir antaśh cha bhūtānām acharaṁ charam eva cha sūkṣhmatvāt tad avijñeyaṁ dūra-sthaṁ chāntike cha tat
english_translation: It is within all beings, yet outside; motionless yet moving; too subtle to be perceived; far away yet ever near.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम्। भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च।।
transliteration_iast: avibhaktaṁ cha bhūteṣhu vibhaktam iva cha sthitam bhūta-bhartṛi cha taj jñeyaṁ grasiṣhṇu prabhaviṣhṇu cha
english_translation: In all beings, undivided yet living in division, it is the upholder of all, both creator and destroyer alike.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते। ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्।।
transliteration_iast: jyotiṣhām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param uchyate jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ jñāna-gamyaṁ hṛidi sarvasya viṣhṭhitam
english_translation: It is the light of lights, beyond the reach of darkness; the wisdom, the only thing worth knowing or that wisdom can teach; the presence in the hearts of all.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः। मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते।।
transliteration_iast: iti kṣhetraṁ tathā jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ choktaṁ samāsataḥ mad-bhakta etad vijñāya mad-bhāvāyopapadyate
english_translation: Thus, I have briefly told you what Matter is, the Self worth realizing, and what Wisdom is. He who is devoted to Me knows, and he will assuredly enter into Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि। विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान्।।
transliteration_iast: prakṛitiṁ puruṣhaṁ chaiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api vikārānśh cha guṇānśh chaiva viddhi prakṛiti-sambhavān
english_translation: Know further that Nature and God have no beginning, and that differences in character and quality originate from Nature only.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते। पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: kārya-kāraṇa-kartṛitve hetuḥ prakṛitir uchyate puruṣhaḥ sukha-duḥkhānāṁ bhoktṛitve hetur uchyate
english_translation: Nature is the law that generates cause and effect; God is the source of all pleasure and pain.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान्। कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु।।
transliteration_iast: puruṣhaḥ prakṛiti-stho hi bhuṅkte prakṛiti-jān guṇān kāraṇaṁ guṇa-saṅgo ’sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu
english_translation: God, dwelling in the heart of Nature, experiences the qualities that Nature brings forth; and His affinity towards these qualities is the reason for His living in a good or evil body.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: उपद्रष्टाऽनुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः। परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः।।
transliteration_iast: upadraṣhṭānumantā cha bhartā bhoktā maheśhvaraḥ paramātmeti chāpy ukto dehe ’smin puruṣhaḥ paraḥ
english_translation: Thus, in the body of man dwells the Supreme God; He who sees, permits, upholds, and enjoys is the Highest God and the Highest Self.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैःसह। सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते।।
transliteration_iast: ya evaṁ vetti puruṣhaṁ prakṛitiṁ cha guṇaiḥ saha sarvathā vartamāno ’pi na sa bhūyo ’bhijāyate
english_translation: He who understands God and Nature, along with her qualities, whatever his condition in life may be, will not come back to earth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना। अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे।।
transliteration_iast: dhyānenātmani paśhyanti kechid ātmānam ātmanā anye sānkhyena yogena karma-yogena chāpare
english_translation: Some realize the Supreme by meditating, with its aid, on the Self within; others by pure reason; and still others by right action.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वाऽन्येभ्य उपासते। तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः।।
transliteration_iast: anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śhrutvānyebhya upāsate te ’pi chātitaranty eva mṛityuṁ śhruti-parāyaṇāḥ
english_translation: Others, again, having no direct knowledge but only hearing from others, still worship, and, if they are true to the teachings, they too will cross the sea of death.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यावत्सञ्जायते किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्। क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ।।
transliteration_iast: yāvat sañjāyate kiñchit sattvaṁ sthāvara-jaṅgamam kṣhetra-kṣhetrajña-sanyogāt tad viddhi bharatarṣhabha
english_translation: Wherever life is seen in things movable or immovable, it is the result of the combination of Matter and Spirit.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्। विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।
transliteration_iast: samaṁ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu tiṣhṭhantaṁ parameśhvaram vinaśhyatsv avinaśhyantaṁ yaḥ paśhyati sa paśhyati
english_translation: He who can see the Supreme Lord in all beings, the Imperishable amidst the perishable, he is the one who truly sees.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्। न हिनस्त्यात्मनाऽऽत्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्।।
transliteration_iast: samaṁ paśhyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśhvaram na hinasty ātmanātmānaṁ tato yāti parāṁ gatim
english_translation: Beholding the Lord equally in all things, his actions do not mar his spiritual life but lead him to the heights of bliss.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः। यः पश्यति तथाऽऽत्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति।।
transliteration_iast: prakṛityaiva cha karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśhaḥ yaḥ paśhyati tathātmānam akartāraṁ sa paśhyati
english_translation: He who understands that it is only the Law of Nature that brings action to fruition, and that the Self never acts, alone knows the Truth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति। तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।।
transliteration_iast: yadā bhūta-pṛithag-bhāvam eka-stham anupaśhyati tata eva cha vistāraṁ brahma sampadyate tadā
english_translation: He who sees the diverse forms of life all rooted in One and growing forth from Him, shall indeed find the Absolute.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः। शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते।।
transliteration_iast: anāditvān nirguṇatvāt paramātmāyam avyayaḥ śharīra-stho ’pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
english_translation: The Supreme Spirit, O Prince, is without beginning, has no qualities, and is imperishable. Though it is within the body, it does not act, nor is it affected by action.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते। सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथाऽऽत्मा नोपलिप्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yathā sarva-gataṁ saukṣhmyād ākāśhaṁ nopalipyate sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate
english_translation: As space, though present everywhere, remains unaffected due to its subtlety, so too the Self, though present in all forms, retains its purity unalloyed.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः। क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत।।
transliteration_iast: yathā prakāśhayaty ekaḥ kṛitsnaṁ lokam imaṁ raviḥ kṣhetraṁ kṣhetrī tathā kṛitsnaṁ prakāśhayati bhārata
english_translation: As the one Sun illuminates the entire earth, so the Lord illuminates the entire universe.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा। भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्।।
transliteration_iast: kṣhetra-kṣhetrajñayor evam antaraṁ jñāna-chakṣhuṣhā bhūta-prakṛiti-mokṣhaṁ cha ye vidur yānti te param
english_translation: Those who, with the eyes of wisdom, thus see the difference between Matter and Spirit, and know how to liberate life from the Law of Nature, attain the Supreme.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्। यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha paraṁ bhūyaḥ pravakṣhyāmi jñānānāṁ jñānam uttamam yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṁ siddhim ito gatāḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Now I will reveal to you the wisdom that is beyond knowledge, by attaining which the sages have reached perfection.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः। सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च।।
transliteration_iast: idaṁ jñānam upāśhritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ sarge ’pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti cha
english_translation: Dwelling in wisdom and realizing My divinity, they are not reborn when the universe is recreated at the beginning of every cycle, nor are they affected when it is dissolved.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन् गर्भं दधाम्यहम्। संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत।।
transliteration_iast: mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṁ dadhāmy aham sambhavaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ tato bhavati bhārata
english_translation: The eternal cosmos is My womb, in which I plant the seed from which all beings are born, O prince!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः। तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-yoniṣhu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ tāsāṁ brahma mahad yonir ahaṁ bīja-pradaḥ pitā
english_translation: O illustrious son of Kunti! Through whatever wombs men are born, it is the Spirit itself that conceives, and I am their father.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः। निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्।।
transliteration_iast: sattvaṁ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛiti-sambhavāḥ nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam
english_translation: Purity, passion, and ignorance are the qualities that the law of nature brings forth. They fetter the free spirit in all beings.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्। सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ।।
transliteration_iast: tatra sattvaṁ nirmalatvāt prakāśhakam anāmayam sukha-saṅgena badhnāti jñāna-saṅgena chānagha
english_translation: O Sinless One! Of these, purity, being luminous, strong, and invulnerable, binds one with its yearning for happiness and illumination.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्। तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्।।
transliteration_iast: rajo rāgātmakaṁ viddhi tṛiṣhṇā-saṅga-samudbhavam tan nibadhnāti kaunteya karma-saṅgena dehinam
english_translation: Passion, engendered by thirst for pleasure and attachment, binds the soul through its fondness for activities.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्। प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत।।
transliteration_iast: tamas tv ajñāna-jaṁ viddhi mohanaṁ sarva-dehinām pramādālasya-nidrābhis tan nibadhnāti bhārata
english_translation: But Ignorance, the product of darkness, stupefies the senses of all embodied beings, binding them with chains of folly, indolence, and lethargy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत। ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत।।
transliteration_iast: sattvaṁ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata jñānam āvṛitya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayaty uta
english_translation: Purity brings happiness, passion brings commotion, and ignorance, which obscures wisdom, leads to a life of failure.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत। रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा।।
transliteration_iast: rajas tamaśh chābhibhūya sattvaṁ bhavati bhārata rajaḥ sattvaṁ tamaśh chaiva tamaḥ sattvaṁ rajas tathā
english_translation: O Prince! Purity prevails when passion and ignorance are overcome; passion, when purity and ignorance are overcome; and ignorance when it is overcome by purity and passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते। ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-dvāreṣhu dehe ’smin prakāśha upajāyate jñānaṁ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛiddhaṁ sattvam ity uta
english_translation: When the light of knowledge gleams forth from all the gates of the body, then be sure that purity prevails.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा। रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ।।
transliteration_iast: lobhaḥ pravṛittir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśhamaḥ spṛihā rajasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe bharatarṣhabha
english_translation: O best of Indians! Avarice, the impulse to act, and the beginning of action itself are all due to the dominance of passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च। तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन।।
transliteration_iast: aprakāśho ’pravṛittiśh cha pramādo moha eva cha tamasy etāni jāyante vivṛiddhe kuru-nandana
english_translation: Darkness, stagnation, folly, and infatuation are the results of the dominance of ignorance, O joy of the Kuru clan!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्। तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yadā sattve pravṛiddhe tu pralayaṁ yāti deha-bhṛit tadottama-vidāṁ lokān amalān pratipadyate
english_translation: When purity prevails, the soul, upon leaving the body, passes on to the pure regions where those who know the Highest reside.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते। तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते।।
transliteration_iast: rajasi pralayaṁ gatvā karma-saṅgiṣhu jāyate tathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣhu jāyate
english_translation: When passion prevails, the soul is reborn among those who love activity; when ignorance rules, it enters the wombs of the ignorant.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्। रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्।।
transliteration_iast: karmaṇaḥ sukṛitasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṁ nirmalaṁ phalam rajasas tu phalaṁ duḥkham ajñānaṁ tamasaḥ phalam
english_translation: They say the fruit of a meritorious action is spotless and pure; the outcome of passion is misery, and of ignorance, darkness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च। प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च।।
transliteration_iast: sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṁ rajaso lobha eva cha pramāda-mohau tamaso bhavato ’jñānam eva cha
english_translation: Purity engenders wisdom, passion avarice, and ignorance folly, infatuation, and darkness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः। जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः।।
transliteration_iast: ūrdhvaṁ gachchhanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣhṭhanti rājasāḥ jaghanya-guṇa-vṛitti-sthā adho gachchhanti tāmasāḥ
english_translation: When purity is in the ascendant, the man evolves; when passion is in the ascendant, he neither evolves nor degenerates; when ignorance is in the ascendant, he is lost.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति। गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: nānyaṁ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṁ yadā draṣhṭānupaśhyati guṇebhyaśh cha paraṁ vetti mad-bhāvaṁ so ’dhigachchhati
english_translation: As soon as one understands that it is only the qualities that act and nothing else, and perceives that which is beyond, they attain My divine nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्। जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते।।
transliteration_iast: guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān janma-mṛityu-jarā-duḥkhair vimukto ’mṛitam aśhnute
english_translation: When the soul transcends the Qualities, which are the real cause of physical existence, then, freed from birth and death, from old age and misery, he drinks the nectar of immortality.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच कैर्लिंगैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो। किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha kair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho kim āchāraḥ kathaṁ chaitāns trīn guṇān ativartate
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, how can one recognize someone who has transcended the qualities? How do they act and live beyond them?"
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव। न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha prakāśhaṁ cha pravṛittiṁ cha moham eva cha pāṇḍava na dveṣhṭi sampravṛittāni na nivṛittāni kāṅkṣhati
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Prince! He who does not shun the quality that is present and does not long for that which is absent;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते। गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते।।
transliteration_iast: udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vichālyate guṇā vartanta ity evaṁ yo ’vatiṣhṭhati neṅgate
english_translation: He who maintains an attitude of indifference, who is not disturbed by the qualities, who realizes that it is only they who act, and remains calm;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः। तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः।।
transliteration_iast: sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ sva-sthaḥ sama-loṣhṭāśhma-kāñchanaḥ tulya-priyāpriyo dhīras tulya-nindātma-sanstutiḥ
english_translation: Who accepts pain and pleasure as they come, is centered in their Self, to whom a piece of clay, stone, or gold are all the same, who neither likes nor dislikes, who is steadfast, indifferent alike to praise or censure;
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः। सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: mānāpamānayos tulyas tulyo mitrāri-pakṣhayoḥ sarvārambha-parityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa uchyate
english_translation: Who looks equally upon honor and dishonor, loves friends and foes alike, and abandons all initiative, such is he who transcends the qualities.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्ितयोगेन सेवते। स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान् ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।
transliteration_iast: māṁ cha yo ’vyabhichāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate sa guṇān samatītyaitān brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
english_translation: And he who serves Me alone, with unwavering devotion, shall overcome the Qualities and become one with the Eternal.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाऽहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च। शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च।।
transliteration_iast: brahmaṇo hi pratiṣhṭhāham amṛitasyāvyayasya cha śhāśhvatasya cha dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya cha
english_translation: For I am the home of the spirit, the continual source of immortality, eternal righteousness, and infinite joy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्। छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha ūrdhva-mūlam adhaḥ-śhākham aśhvatthaṁ prāhur avyayam chhandānsi yasya parṇāni yas taṁ veda sa veda-vit
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna continued: This phenomenal creation, which is both ephemeral and eternal, is like a tree, with its seed above in the Highest and its ramifications below on this earth. The scriptures are its leaves, and he who understands this knows.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः। अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके।।
transliteration_iast: adhaśh chordhvaṁ prasṛitās tasya śhākhā guṇa-pravṛiddhā viṣhaya-pravālāḥ adhaśh cha mūlāny anusantatāni karmānubandhīni manuṣhya-loke
english_translation: Its branches shoot upwards and downwards, deriving their nourishment from the qualities; its buds are the objects of sense; and its roots, which follow the law, causing man's regeneration and degeneration, pierce downwards into the soil.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा। अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा।।
transliteration_iast: na rūpam asyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na chādir na cha sampratiṣhṭhā aśhvattham enaṁ su-virūḍha-mūlam asaṅga-śhastreṇa dṛiḍhena chhittvā
english_translation: In this world, its true form is not known, neither its origin nor its end, and its strength is not understood—until the tree, with its roots striking deep into the earth, is hewn down by the sharp axe of non-attachment.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्य यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः। तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी।।
transliteration_iast: tataḥ padaṁ tat parimārgitavyaṁ yasmin gatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ tam eva chādyaṁ puruṣhaṁ prapadye yataḥ pravṛittiḥ prasṛitā purāṇī
english_translation: Beyond lies the path, from which, once found, there is no return. This is the Primal God from whom this ancient creation has sprung.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः। द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्।।
transliteration_iast: nirmāna-mohā jita-saṅga-doṣhā adhyātma-nityā vinivṛitta-kāmāḥ dvandvair vimuktāḥ sukha-duḥkha-sanjñair gachchhanty amūḍhāḥ padam avyayaṁ tat
english_translation: The wise attain Eternity when, freed from pride and delusion, they have conquered their love for the things of sense; when, renouncing desire and fixing their gaze on the Self, they cease to be tossed to and fro by the opposing sensations, such as pleasure and pain.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः। यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।
transliteration_iast: na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śhaśhāṅko na pāvakaḥ yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṁ mama
english_translation: Neither the sun, nor the moon, nor fire shines there. Those who go there never come back. For, O Arjuna, that is my celestial home!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः। मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति।।
transliteration_iast: mamaivānśho jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ manaḥ-ṣhaṣhṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛiti-sthāni karṣhati
english_translation: It is only a very small part of My Eternal Self, which is the life of the universe, that draws around itself the six senses, with the mind being the last, which have their source in Nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः। गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्।।
transliteration_iast: śharīraṁ yad avāpnoti yach chāpy utkrāmatīśhvaraḥ gṛihītvaitāni sanyāti vāyur gandhān ivāśhayāt
