english_translation: When the Supreme Lord enters a body or leaves it, He gathers these senses together and travels with them, as the wind gathers perfume while passing through the flowers.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च। अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते।।
transliteration_iast: śhrotraṁ chakṣhuḥ sparśhanaṁ cha rasanaṁ ghrāṇam eva cha adhiṣhṭhāya manaśh chāyaṁ viṣhayān upasevate
english_translation: He is the perception of the ear, the eye, the touch, the taste, the smell, and the mind; and the enjoyment of the things they perceive is also His.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्। विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः।।
transliteration_iast: utkrāmantaṁ sthitaṁ vāpi bhuñjānaṁ vā guṇānvitam vimūḍhā nānupaśhyanti paśhyanti jñāna-chakṣhuṣhaḥ
english_translation: The ignorant do not see that it is He who is present in life and departs at death, or even that it is He who enjoys pleasure through the qualities. Only the eye of wisdom sees this.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्। यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः।।
transliteration_iast: yatanto yoginaśh chainaṁ paśhyanty ātmany avasthitam yatanto ‘py akṛitātmāno nainaṁ paśhyanty achetasaḥ
english_translation: The saints, with great effort, find Him within themselves; however, the unintelligent, despite their efforts, cannot control their minds.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्। यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्।।
transliteration_iast: yad āditya-gataṁ tejo jagad bhāsayate ’khilam yach chandramasi yach chāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam
english_translation: Remember that the light which proceeds from the sun, illuminating the whole world, and the light which is in the moon, and that which is in the fire, all are born of me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा। पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः।।
transliteration_iast: gām āviśhya cha bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā puṣhṇāmi chauṣhadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
english_translation: I enter this world and animate all My creatures with My vitality; and by My cool moonbeams, I nourish the plants.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः। प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्।।
transliteration_iast: ahaṁ vaiśhvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṁ deham āśhritaḥ prāṇāpāna-samāyuktaḥ pachāmy annaṁ chatur-vidham
english_translation: Becoming the fire of life, I pass into their bodies and, uniting with the vital streams of Prāṇa and Apāna, I digest the various kinds of food.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च। वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्।।
transliteration_iast: sarvasya chāhaṁ hṛidi sanniviṣhṭo mattaḥ smṛitir jñānam apohanaṁ cha vedaiśh cha sarvair aham eva vedyo vedānta-kṛid veda-vid eva chāham
english_translation: I am enthroned in the hearts of all; memory, wisdom, and discrimination owe their origins to Me. I am He Who is to be realized in the scriptures; I inspire their wisdom, and I know their truth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च। क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: dvāv imau puruṣhau loke kṣharaśh chākṣhara eva cha kṣharaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭa-stho ’kṣhara uchyate
english_translation: There are two aspects in Nature: the perishable and the imperishable. All life in this world belongs to the former, while the unchanging element belongs to the latter.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः। यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः।।
transliteration_iast: uttamaḥ puruṣhas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛitaḥ yo loka-trayam āviśhya bibharty avyaya īśhvaraḥ
english_translation: But I am higher than all, the Supreme God, the Absolute Self, the Eternal Lord, who pervades and upholds all the worlds.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः। अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः।।
transliteration_iast: yasmāt kṣharam atīto ’ham akṣharād api chottamaḥ ato ’smi loke vede cha prathitaḥ puruṣhottamaḥ
english_translation: I am beyond comparison with the Eternal and the non-eternal; I am known as the Supreme Personality, the Highest God, by scriptures and sages.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम्। स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत।।
transliteration_iast: yo mām evam asammūḍho jānāti puruṣhottamam sa sarva-vid bhajati māṁ sarva-bhāvena bhārata
english_translation: He who, with unclouded vision, sees Me as the Lord-God, knows all that there is to be known and will always worship Me with his whole heart.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयाऽनघ। एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत।।
transliteration_iast: iti guhyatamaṁ śhāstram idam uktaṁ mayānagha etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛita-kṛityaśh cha bhārata
english_translation: Thus, O sinless one, I have revealed this most mystic knowledge to thee. He who understands it gains wisdom and attains the consummation of life.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिः ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः। दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha abhayaṁ sattva-sanśhuddhir jñāna-yoga-vyavasthitiḥ dānaṁ damaśh cha yajñaśh cha svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna continued: Fearlessness, clean living, unceasing concentration on wisdom, readiness to give, self-control, a spirit of sacrifice, regular study of the scriptures, austerity, candor,
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्। दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्।।
transliteration_iast: ahinsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śhāntir apaiśhunam dayā bhūteṣhv aloluptvaṁ mārdavaṁ hrīr achāpalam
english_translation: Harmlessness, truth, absence of wrath, renunciation, contentment, straightforwardness, compassion towards all, uncovetousness, courtesy, modesty, and constancy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता। भवन्ति सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत।।
transliteration_iast: tejaḥ kṣhamā dhṛitiḥ śhaucham adroho nāti-mānitā bhavanti sampadaṁ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata
english_translation: Valor, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, freedom from hate and vanity—these are the qualities of one who possesses the divine, O Arjuna!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च। अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पदमासुरीम्।।
transliteration_iast: dambho darpo ’bhimānaśh cha krodhaḥ pāruṣhyam eva cha ajñānaṁ chābhijātasya pārtha sampadam āsurīm
english_translation: Hypocrisy, pride, insolence, cruelty, and ignorance belong to those born of godless qualities.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता। मा शुचः सम्पदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव।।
transliteration_iast: daivī sampad vimokṣhāya nibandhāyāsurī matā mā śhuchaḥ sampadaṁ daivīm abhijāto ’si pāṇḍava
english_translation: Godly qualities lead to liberation; godless ones lead to bondage. Do not be anxious, Prince! You have the Godly qualities.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन् दैव आसुर एव च। दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श्रृणु।।
transliteration_iast: dvau bhūta-sargau loke ’smin daiva āsura eva cha daivo vistaraśhaḥ prokta āsuraṁ pārtha me śhṛiṇu
english_translation: No changes needed.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः। न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते।।
transliteration_iast: pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha janā na vidur āsurāḥ na śhauchaṁ nāpi chāchāro na satyaṁ teṣhu vidyate
english_translation: The godless do not know how to act or renounce; they lack both purity and truth. They do not understand the right principles of conduct.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्। अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्।।
transliteration_iast: asatyam apratiṣhṭhaṁ te jagad āhur anīśhvaram aparaspara-sambhūtaṁ kim anyat kāma-haitukam
english_translation: They say the universe is an accident with no purpose and no God. Life is created through sexual union, a product of lust and nothing else.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः। प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः।।
transliteration_iast: etāṁ dṛiṣhṭim avaṣhṭabhya naṣhṭātmāno ’lpa-buddhayaḥ prabhavanty ugra-karmāṇaḥ kṣhayāya jagato ’hitāḥ
english_translation: Thinking thus, these degraded souls, these enemies of mankind—whose intelligence is negligible and whose deeds are monstrous—come into the world only to destroy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः। मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः।।
transliteration_iast: kāmam āśhritya duṣhpūraṁ dambha-māna-madānvitāḥ mohād gṛihītvāsad-grāhān pravartante ’śhuchi-vratāḥ
english_translation: Giving themselves up to insatiable passions, hypocritically, self-sufficiently, and arrogantly, cherishing false conceptions founded on delusion, they work only to carry out their own unholy purposes.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः। कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्िचताः।।
transliteration_iast: chintām aparimeyāṁ cha pralayāntām upāśhritāḥ kāmopabhoga-paramā etāvad iti niśhchitāḥ
english_translation: Poring anxiously over evil resolutions that only end in death, seeking only the gratification of desire as the highest goal, and seeing nothing beyond—
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः। ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्।।
transliteration_iast: āśhā-pāśha-śhatair baddhāḥ kāma-krodha-parāyaṇāḥ īhante kāma-bhogārtham anyāyenārtha-sañchayān
english_translation: Caught in the toils of a hundred vain hopes, enslaved by passion and wrath, they accumulate hoards of unjust wealth, only to indulge their sensual desires.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम्। इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्।।
transliteration_iast: idam adya mayā labdham imaṁ prāpsye manoratham idam astīdam api me bhaviṣhyati punar dhanam
english_translation: Today I have gained this; tomorrow I will fulfill another desire; this wealth is mine now, and the rest will soon be mine.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि। ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी।।
transliteration_iast: asau mayā hataḥ śhatrur haniṣhye chāparān api īśhvaro ’ham ahaṁ bhogī siddho ’haṁ balavān sukhī
english_translation: I have slain one enemy; I will slay the others too. I am worthy of enjoying; I am the Almighty, perfect, powerful, and happy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया। यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः।।
transliteration_iast: āḍhyo ’bhijanavān asmi ko ’nyo ’sti sadṛiśho mayā yakṣhye dāsyāmi modiṣhya ity ajñāna-vimohitāḥ aneka-chitta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛitāḥ prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣhu patanti narake ’śhuchau
english_translation: I am wealthy, I am of noble birth; who can compare with me? I will sacrifice, I will give, I will pay—and I will enjoy. Thus blinded by ignorance,
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः। प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ।।
transliteration_iast: aneka-citta-vibhrāntā moha-jāla-samāvṛtāḥ prasaktāḥ kāma-bhogeṣu patanti narake 'śucau
english_translation: Perplexed by discordant thoughts, entangled in the snares of desire, infatuated by passion, they sink into the depths of hell.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः। यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्।।
transliteration_iast: ātma-sambhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhana-māna-madānvitāḥ yajante nāma-yajñais te dambhenāvidhi-pūrvakam
english_translation: Self-conceited, stubborn, wealthy, proud, and insolent, they make a show of their patronage, disregarding the norms of propriety.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः। मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः।।
transliteration_iast: ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ cha sanśhritāḥ mām ātma-para-deheṣhu pradviṣhanto ’bhyasūyakāḥ
english_translation: Puffed up by power and inordinate conceit, swayed by lust and wrath, these wicked people hate Me, Who am within them as I am within all.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्। क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु।।
transliteration_iast: tān ahaṁ dviṣhataḥ krūrān sansāreṣhu narādhamān kṣhipāmy ajasram aśhubhān āsurīṣhv eva yoniṣhu
english_translation: Those who thus hate Me, who are cruel, the dregs of mankind, I condemn them to a continuous, miserable, and godless rebirth.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: असुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि। मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्।।
transliteration_iast: āsurīṁ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṁ gatim
english_translation: So, reborn, they spend life after life enveloped in delusion, and they never reach Me, O Prince, but degenerate into even lower forms of life.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः। कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्।।
transliteration_iast: tri-vidhaṁ narakasyedaṁ dvāraṁ nāśhanam ātmanaḥ kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṁ tyajet
english_translation: The gates of hell are three: lust, wrath, and avarice; they destroy the Self, so avoid them.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः। आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्।।
transliteration_iast: etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamo-dvārais tribhir naraḥ ācharaty ātmanaḥ śhreyas tato yāti parāṁ gatim
english_translation: These are the gates that lead to darkness; if one avoids them, they will ensure their own welfare and eventually attain liberation.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः। न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्।।
transliteration_iast: yaḥ śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya vartate kāma-kārataḥ na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim
english_translation: But he who neglects the commands of the scriptures and follows the promptings of passion does not attain perfection, happiness, or the final goal.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ। ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि।।
transliteration_iast: tasmāch chhāstraṁ pramāṇaṁ te kāryākārya-vyavasthitau jñātvā śhāstra-vidhānoktaṁ karma kartum ihārhasi
english_translation: Therefore, whenever there is doubt as to whether you should do something or not, let the scriptures guide your conduct. In the light of the scriptures, you should labor your whole life.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः। तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha ye śhāstra-vidhim utsṛijya yajante śhraddhayānvitāḥ teṣhāṁ niṣhṭhā tu kā kṛiṣhṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "My Lord, what is the condition of those who perform acts of sacrifice not according to the scriptures, but with implicit faith? Is it one of purity, passion, or ignorance?"
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा। सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां श्रृणु।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha tri-vidhā bhavati śhraddhā dehināṁ sā svabhāva-jā sāttvikī rājasī chaiva tāmasī cheti tāṁ śhṛiṇu
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: Man has an inherent faith in one or another of the qualities—purity, passion, and ignorance. Now, listen.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत। श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः।।
transliteration_iast: sattvānurūpā sarvasya śhraddhā bhavati bhārata śhraddhā-mayo ‘yaṁ puruṣho yo yach-chhraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
english_translation: Every person's faith conforms to their nature. By nature, they are full of faith. They are, in fact, what their faith makes them.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः। प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः।।
transliteration_iast: yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣha-rakṣhānsi rājasāḥ pretān bhūta-gaṇānśh chānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
english_translation: The pure worship the true God; the passionate, the powers of wealth and magic; the ignorant, the spirits of the dead and lower orders of nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः। दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः।।
transliteration_iast: aśhāstra-vihitaṁ ghoraṁ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ dambhāhankāra-sanyuktāḥ kāma-rāga-balānvitāḥ
english_translation: Those who practice austerities not commanded by scripture, who are enslaved to hypocrisy and egotism, who are carried away by the fury of desire and passion,
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः। मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्।।
transliteration_iast: karṣhayantaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ bhūta-grāmam achetasaḥ māṁ chaivāntaḥ śharīra-sthaṁ tān viddhy āsura-niśhchayān
english_translation: They are ignorant and torment the organs of the body, harassing Me who lives within. Know that they are devoted to evil.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः। यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं श्रृणु।।
transliteration_iast: āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ yajñas tapas tathā dānaṁ teṣhāṁ bhedam imaṁ śhṛiṇu
english_translation: The food that people enjoy is also threefold, like the ways of sacrifice, austerity, and almsgiving. Listen to the distinction.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः। रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः।।
transliteration_iast: āyuḥ-sattva-balārogya-sukha-prīti-vivardhanāḥ rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛidyā āhārāḥ sāttvika-priyāḥ
english_translation: The foods that prolong life, increase purity, vigour, health, cheerfulness, and happiness are those that are delicious, soothing, substantial, and agreeable; these are loved by the pure.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः। आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः।।
transliteration_iast: kaṭv-amla-lavaṇāty-uṣhṇa- tīkṣhṇa-rūkṣha-vidāhinaḥ āhārā rājasasyeṣhṭā duḥkha-śhokāmaya-pradāḥ
english_translation: Those in whom passion is dominant like foods that are bitter, sour, salty, overly hot, pungent, dry, and burning. These produce unhappiness, repentance, and disease.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्। उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्।।
transliteration_iast: yāta-yāmaṁ gata-rasaṁ pūti paryuṣhitaṁ cha yat uchchhiṣhṭam api chāmedhyaṁ bhojanaṁ tāmasa-priyam
english_translation: The ignorant love food that is stale, not nourishing, putrid, and corrupt; the leftovers of others, and unclean.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते। यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः।।
transliteration_iast: aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yajño vidhi-driṣhṭo ya ijyate yaṣhṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ
english_translation: Sacrifice is pure when it is offered by one who does not covet the fruit of it, when it is done according to the commands of scripture, and with implicit faith that the sacrifice is a duty.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्। इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्।।
transliteration_iast: abhisandhāya tu phalaṁ dambhārtham api chaiva yat ijyate bharata-śhreṣhṭha taṁ yajñaṁ viddhi rājasam
english_translation: Sacrifice which is performed for the sake of its results, or for self-glorification - that, O best of Aryans, is the product of passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम्। श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते।।
transliteration_iast: vidhi-hīnam asṛiṣhṭānnaṁ mantra-hīnam adakṣhiṇam śhraddhā-virahitaṁ yajñaṁ tāmasaṁ parichakṣhate
english_translation: Sacrifice that is contrary to scriptural command, that is unaccompanied by prayers or gifts of food or money, and is without faith—that is the product of ignorance.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम्। ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: deva-dwija-guru-prājña- pūjanaṁ śhaucham ārjavam brahmacharyam ahinsā cha śhārīraṁ tapa uchyate
english_translation: Worship of God and the Master; respect for the preacher and the philosopher; purity, rectitude, continence, and harmlessness—all of these constitute physical austerity.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्। स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: anudvega-karaṁ vākyaṁ satyaṁ priya-hitaṁ cha yat svādhyāyābhyasanaṁ chaiva vāṅ-mayaṁ tapa uchyate
english_translation: Speech that hurts no one, that is true, pleasant to listen to, and beneficial, and the constant study of the scriptures—this is austerity of speech.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः। भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: manaḥ-prasādaḥ saumyatvaṁ maunam ātma-vinigrahaḥ bhāva-sanśhuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam uchyate
english_translation: Serenity, kindness, silence, self-control, and purity—these are the austerities of the mind.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्ित्रविधं नरैः। अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते।।
transliteration_iast: śhraddhayā parayā taptaṁ tapas tat tri-vidhaṁ naraiḥ aphalākāṅkṣhibhir yuktaiḥ sāttvikaṁ parichakṣhate
english_translation: These threefold austerities, performed with faith and without thought of reward, can truly be considered pure.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत्। क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्।।
transliteration_iast: satkāra-māna-pūjārthaṁ tapo dambhena chaiva yat kriyate tad iha proktaṁ rājasaṁ chalam adhruvam
english_translation: Austerity coupled with hypocrisy, or performed for the sake of self-glorification, popularity, or vanity, comes from passion, and its result is always uncertain and temporary.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः। परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: mūḍha-grāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ parasyotsādanārthaṁ vā tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
english_translation: Austerity done under delusion, and accompanied with sorcery or the infliction of pain upon oneself or another, may be assumed to spring from ignorance.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे। देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: dātavyam iti yad dānaṁ dīyate ‘nupakāriṇe deśhe kāle cha pātre cha tad dānaṁ sāttvikaṁ smṛitam
english_translation: The gift that is given without thought of recompense, believing it should be made, in an appropriate place, at an opportune time, and to a deserving person—such a gift is pure.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः। दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: yat tu pratyupakārārthaṁ phalam uddiśhya vā punaḥ dīyate cha parikliṣhṭaṁ tad dānaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam
english_translation: That which is given for the sake of the results it will produce, or with the hope of recompense, or grudgingly—that may truly be said to be the outcome of passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते। असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: adeśha-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaśh cha dīyate asat-kṛitam avajñātaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
english_translation: And that which is given at an inappropriate place or time or to one who is undeserving, or with disrespect or contempt - such a gift is the result of ignorance.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः। ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा।।
transliteration_iast: oṁ tat sad iti nirdeśho brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛitaḥ brāhmaṇās tena vedāśh cha yajñāśh cha vihitāḥ purā
english_translation: Om Tat Sat is the triple designation of the Eternal Spirit, by which the Vedic Scriptures, ceremonials, and sacrifices were ordained of old.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः। प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्।।
transliteration_iast: tasmād oṁ ity udāhṛitya yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṁ brahma-vādinām
english_translation: Therefore, all acts of sacrifice, gifts, and austerities prescribed by the scriptures are always begun by those who understand the Spirit with the word "Om."
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः। दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षि।।
transliteration_iast: tad ity anabhisandhāya phalaṁ yajña-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ dāna-kriyāśh cha vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣha-kāṅkṣhibhiḥ
english_translation: Those who desire deliverance begin their acts of sacrifice, austerity, or gift with the word "Tat" (meaning "That"), without thought of reward.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते। प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते।।
transliteration_iast: sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve cha sad ity etat prayujyate praśhaste karmaṇi tathā sach-chhabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
english_translation: Sat' means Reality or the highest Good, and also, O Arjuna, it is used to denote an action of exceptional merit.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते। कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते।।
transliteration_iast: yajñe tapasi dāne cha sthitiḥ sad iti chochyate karma chaiva tad-arthīyaṁ sad ity evābhidhīyate
english_translation: Conviction in sacrifice, austerity, and giving is also called Sat. So too, an action done only for the Lord's sake.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्। असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह।।
transliteration_iast: aśhraddhayā hutaṁ dattaṁ tapas taptaṁ kṛitaṁ cha yat asad ity uchyate pārtha na cha tat pretya no iha
english_translation: Whatever is done without faith, whether it be sacrifice, austerity, gift, or anything else, is called Asat (meaning "Unreal"), for it is the negation of Sat, O Arjuna! Such an act has no significance, here or hereafter.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम्। त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha sannyāsasya mahā-bāho tattvam ichchhāmi veditum tyāgasya cha hṛiṣhīkeśha pṛithak keśhi-niṣhūdana
english_translation: Arjuna asked, "O Mighty One! I desire to know how relinquishment is distinguished from renunciation.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्री भगवानुवाच काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः। सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः।।
transliteration_iast: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha kāmyānāṁ karmaṇāṁ nyāsaṁ sannyāsaṁ kavayo viduḥ sarva-karma-phala-tyāgaṁ prāhus tyāgaṁ vichakṣhaṇāḥ
english_translation: Lord Shri Krishna replied: The sages say that renunciation is forgoing an action that springs from desire, and relinquishing is the surrender of its fruit.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः। यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे।।
transliteration_iast: tyājyaṁ doṣha-vad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣhiṇaḥ yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyam iti chāpare
english_translation: Some philosophers say that all action is evil and should be abandoned, whereas others maintain that acts of sacrifice, benevolence, and austerity should not be given up.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: निश्चयं श्रृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम। त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः।।
transliteration_iast: niśhchayaṁ śhṛiṇu me tatra tyāge bharata-sattama tyāgo hi puruṣha-vyāghra tri-vidhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ
english_translation: O best of Indians! Listen to my judgment regarding this problem. It has a threefold aspect.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्। यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्।।
transliteration_iast: yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-karma na tyājyaṁ kāryam eva tat yajño dānaṁ tapaśh chaiva pāvanāni manīṣhiṇām
english_translation: Acts of sacrifice, benevolence, and austerity should not be given up, but should be performed, for they purify the aspiring soul.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च। कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्िचतं मतमुत्तमम्।।
transliteration_iast: etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalāni cha kartavyānīti me pārtha niśhchitaṁ matam uttamam
english_translation: But they should be done with detachment and without thought of reward. This is my final judgement.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते। मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः।।
transliteration_iast: niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate mohāt tasya parityāgas tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
english_translation: It is not right to give up actions which are obligatory; and if they are misunderstood, it is the result of sheer ignorance.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत्। स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्।।
transliteration_iast: duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāya-kleśha-bhayāt tyajet sa kṛitvā rājasaṁ tyāgaṁ naiva tyāga-phalaṁ labhet
english_translation: To avoid an action out of fear of physical suffering, as it is likely to be painful, is to act out of passion, and the benefit of renunciation will not be gained.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन। सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः।।
transliteration_iast: kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṁ kriyate ‘rjuna saṅgaṁ tyaktvā phalaṁ chaiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ
english_translation: He who performs an obligatory action, believing it to be a duty that ought to be done, without any personal desire to do the act or to receive any return—such renunciation is pure.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते। त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः।।
transliteration_iast: na dveṣhṭy akuśhalaṁ karma kuśhale nānuṣhajjate tyāgī sattva-samāviṣhṭo medhāvī chhinna-sanśhayaḥ
english_translation: The wise man who has attained purity, whose doubts are resolved, who is filled with the spirit of self-abnegation, does not shy away from action due to its pain, nor does he crave it due to its pleasure.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः। यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते।।
transliteration_iast: na hi deha-bhṛitā śhakyaṁ tyaktuṁ karmāṇy aśheṣhataḥ yas tu karma-phala-tyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate
english_translation: But since those still in the body cannot entirely avoid action, in their case, the abandonment of the fruit of action is considered as complete renunciation.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम्। भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्।।
transliteration_iast: aniṣhṭam iṣhṭaṁ miśhraṁ cha tri-vidhaṁ karmaṇaḥ phalam bhavaty atyāgināṁ pretya na tu sannyāsināṁ kvachit
english_translation: For those who cannot renounce all desires, the fruit of action hereafter is threefold—good, evil, and partly good and partly evil. But for him who has renounced, there is none.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे। सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्।।
transliteration_iast: pañchaitāni mahā-bāho kāraṇāni nibodha me sānkhye kṛitānte proktāni siddhaye sarva-karmaṇām
english_translation: I will now tell you, O Mighty Man, the five causes that must come together, according to the final decision of philosophy, for an action to be accomplished.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्। विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्।।
transliteration_iast: adhiṣhṭhānaṁ tathā kartā karaṇaṁ cha pṛithag-vidham vividhāśh cha pṛithak cheṣhṭā daivaṁ chaivātra pañchamam
english_translation: They have a body, a personality, physical organs, and manifold activities and destinies.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः। न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः।।
transliteration_iast: śharīra-vāṅ-manobhir yat karma prārabhate naraḥ nyāyyaṁ vā viparītaṁ vā pañchaite tasya hetavaḥ
english_translation: Whatever action a person performs, whether by muscular effort, speech, or thought, and whether it be right or wrong, these five are the essential causes.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः। पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः।।
transliteration_iast: tatraivaṁ sati kartāram ātmānaṁ kevalaṁ tu yaḥ paśhyaty akṛita-buddhitvān na sa paśhyati durmatiḥ
english_translation: But the fool, who, due to his immature judgment, supposes that it is his own Self alone that acts, perverts the truth and does not see rightly.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते। हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते।।
transliteration_iast: yasya nāhankṛito bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate hatvā ‘pi sa imāl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate
english_translation: He who has no pride and whose intellect is unalloyed by attachment, even though he kills these people, he does not kill them, and his act does not bind him.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना। करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः।।
transliteration_iast: jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ parijñātā tri-vidhā karma-chodanā karaṇaṁ karma karteti tri-vidhaḥ karma-saṅgrahaḥ
english_translation: Knowledge, the knower, and the object of knowledge are the three incentives to action; and the act, the actor, and the instrument are the threefold constituents.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः। प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि।।
transliteration_iast: jñānaṁ karma cha kartā cha tridhaiva guṇa-bhedataḥ prochyate guṇa-saṅkhyāne yathāvach chhṛiṇu tāny api
english_translation: The knowledge, the action, and the doer differ according to their qualities. Listen to this as well.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते। अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-bhūteṣhu yenaikaṁ bhāvam avyayam īkṣhate avibhaktaṁ vibhakteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi sāttvikam
english_translation: That knowledge which sees the One Indestructible in all beings, the One Indivisible in all separate lives, can be truly called Pure Knowledge.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान्। वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्।।
transliteration_iast: pṛithaktvena tu yaj jñānaṁ nānā-bhāvān pṛithag-vidhān vetti sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu taj jñānaṁ viddhi rājasam
english_translation: The knowledge that perceives the manifold existence in all beings as separate comes from passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम्। अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: yat tu kṛitsna-vad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam atattvārtha-vad alpaṁ cha tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
english_translation: But that which clings blindly to one idea as if it were all, without logic, truth, or insight, has its origin in darkness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्। अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: niyataṁ saṅga-rahitam arāga-dveṣhataḥ kṛitam aphala-prepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam uchyate
english_translation: An obligatory action done by one who is disinterested, who neither likes nor dislikes it, and gives no thought to the consequences that may follow, such an action is Pure.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः। क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhankāreṇa vā punaḥ kriyate bahulāyāsaṁ tad rājasam udāhṛitam
english_translation: But even though an action involves the most strenuous endeavor, yet if the doer is seeking to gratify their desires and is filled with personal vanity, it may be assumed to originate in passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्। मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: anubandhaṁ kṣhayaṁ hinsām anapekṣhya cha pauruṣham mohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam uchyate
english_translation: An action undertaken through delusion, with no regard to the spiritual implications, the capacity of the doer, or the potential harm that may follow, is assumed to be a product of ignorance.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: mukta-saṅgo ‘nahaṁ-vādī dhṛity-utsāha-samanvitaḥ siddhy-asiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika uchyate
english_translation: But when a person has no sentiment or ego, when they possess courage and confidence, not caring whether they succeed or fail, then their action arises from purity.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः। हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः।।
transliteration_iast: rāgī karma-phala-prepsur lubdho hinsātmako ‘śhuchiḥ harṣha-śhokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
english_translation: In one who is impulsive, greedy, looking for reward, violent, impure, and torn between joy and sorrow, it may be assumed that Passion is predominant.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः। विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते।।
transliteration_iast: ayuktaḥ prākṛitaḥ stabdhaḥ śhaṭho naiṣhkṛitiko ‘lasaḥ viṣhādī dīrgha-sūtrī cha kartā tāmasa uchyate
english_translation: While he whose purpose is weak, who is low-minded, stubborn, dishonest, malicious, lazy, despondent, and procrastinating—he may be assumed to be in darkness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं श्रृणु। प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनञ्जय।।
transliteration_iast: buddher bhedaṁ dhṛiteśh chaiva guṇatas tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu prochyamānam aśheṣheṇa pṛithaktvena dhanañjaya
english_translation: Reason and conviction are threefold, according to the quality that is dominant. I will explain them fully and separately, O Arjuna!
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये। बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी।।
transliteration_iast: pravṛittiṁ cha nivṛittiṁ cha kāryākārye bhayābhaye bandhaṁ mokṣhaṁ cha yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
english_translation: That intellect which understands the creation and dissolution of life, what actions should be done and what not, which discriminates between fear and fearlessness, bondage and deliverance, is Pure.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च। अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।
transliteration_iast: yayā dharmam adharmaṁ cha kāryaṁ chākāryam eva cha ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
english_translation: The intellect that does not understand what is right and wrong, and what should be done and not done, is under the sway of Passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसाऽऽवृता। सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी।।
transliteration_iast: adharmaṁ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛitā sarvārthān viparītānśh cha buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
english_translation: And that which, shrouded in Ignorance, thinks wrong to be right, and sees everything perversely, O Arjuna, that intellect is ruled by Darkness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः। योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी।।
transliteration_iast: dhṛityā yayā dhārayate manaḥ-prāṇendriya-kriyāḥ yogenāvyabhichāriṇyā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
english_translation: The conviction and steady concentration with which the mind, the energy, and the senses are controlled—O Arjuna!—are the result of purity.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन। प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी।।
transliteration_iast: yayā tu dharma-kāmārthān dhṛityā dhārayate ‘rjuna prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣhī dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
english_translation: The conviction that always holds fast to rituals, self-interest, and wealth for the sake of what they may bring forth comes from passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च। न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी।।
transliteration_iast: yayā svapnaṁ bhayaṁ śhokaṁ viṣhādaṁ madam eva cha na vimuñchati durmedhā dhṛitiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
english_translation: And that which clings perversely to false idealism, fear, grief, despair, and vanity is the product of ignorance.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ। अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: sukhaṁ tv idānīṁ tri-vidhaṁ śhṛiṇu me bharatarṣhabha abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṁ cha nigachchhati yat tad agre viṣham iva pariṇāme ‘mṛitopamam tat sukhaṁ sāttvikaṁ proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam
english_translation: Hear further the three kinds of pleasure. That which increases day by day delivers one from misery.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम्। तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्।।
transliteration_iast: yat tad agre viṣam iva pariṇāme 'mṛtopamam tat sukhaṁ sāttvikaṁ proktam ātma-buddhi-prasāda-jam
english_translation: Which at first seems like poison but afterwards acts like nectar—that pleasure is pure, for it is born of wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम्। परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: viṣhayendriya-sanyogād yat tad agre ’mṛitopamam pariṇāme viṣham iva tat sukhaṁ rājasaṁ smṛitam
english_translation: That which, at first, is like nectar, as the senses revel in their objects, but in the end acts like poison—that pleasure arises from Passion.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः। निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।
transliteration_iast: yad agre chānubandhe cha sukhaṁ mohanam ātmanaḥ nidrālasya-pramādotthaṁ tat tāmasam udāhṛitam
english_translation: While the pleasure that drugs the senses from start to finish, which springs from indolence, lethargy, and folly—that pleasure flows from Ignorance.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः। सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्ित्रभिर्गुणैः।।
transliteration_iast: na tad asti pṛithivyāṁ vā divi deveṣhu vā punaḥ sattvaṁ prakṛiti-jair muktaṁ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ
english_translation: There is nothing anywhere on earth or in the higher worlds that is free from the three Qualities, for they are born of Nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप। कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः।।
transliteration_iast: brāhmaṇa-kṣhatriya-viśhāṁ śhūdrāṇāṁ cha parantapa karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāva-prabhavair guṇaiḥ
english_translation: O Arjuna! The duties of spiritual teachers, the soldiers, the traders, and the servants have all been fixed according to the dominant quality in their nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च। ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhamo damas tapaḥ śhauchaṁ kṣhāntir ārjavam eva cha jñānaṁ vijñānam āstikyaṁ brahma-karma svabhāva-jam
english_translation: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, uprightness, knowledge, wisdom, and faith in God—these constitute the duty of a spiritual teacher.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम्। दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhauryaṁ tejo dhṛitir dākṣhyaṁ yuddhe chāpy apalāyanam dānam īśhvara-bhāvaśh cha kṣhātraṁ karma svabhāva-jam
english_translation: Valor, glory, firmness, skill, generosity, steadiness in battle, and the ability to rule—these constitute the duty of a soldier. They flow from his own nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम्। परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्।।
transliteration_iast: kṛiṣhi-gau-rakṣhya-vāṇijyaṁ vaiśhya-karma svabhāva-jam paricharyātmakaṁ karma śhūdrasyāpi svabhāva-jam
english_translation: Agriculture, the protection of cows, and trade are the duties of a trader, in accordance with his nature. The duty of a servant is to serve, which also agrees with his nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः। स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु।।
transliteration_iast: sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ sansiddhiṁ labhate naraḥ sva-karma-nirataḥ siddhiṁ yathā vindati tach chhṛiṇu
english_translation: Perfection is attained when one diligently attends to their duty. Listen, and I will tell you how it is attained by one who always minds their own duty.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम्। स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः।।
transliteration_iast: yataḥ pravṛittir bhūtānāṁ yena sarvam idaṁ tatam sva-karmaṇā tam abhyarchya siddhiṁ vindati mānavaḥ
english_translation: One reaches perfection by dedicating their actions to God, Who is the source of all being and fills everything.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्। स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhreyān swa-dharmo viguṇaḥ para-dharmāt sv-anuṣhṭhitāt svabhāva-niyataṁ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣham
english_translation: It is better to do one's own duty, however defective it may be, than to follow the duty of another, however well one may perform it. He who does his duty as his own nature reveals it, never commits a sin.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्। सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः।।
transliteration_iast: saha-jaṁ karma kaunteya sa-doṣham api na tyajet sarvārambhā hi doṣheṇa dhūmenāgnir ivāvṛitāḥ
english_translation: The duty that falls to one's lot of its own accord should not be abandoned, though it may have its defects. All acts are marred by defects, just as fire is obscured by smoke.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः। नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति।।
transliteration_iast: asakta-buddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigata-spṛihaḥ naiṣhkarmya-siddhiṁ paramāṁ sannyāsenādhigachchhati
english_translation: He whose mind is entirely detached, who has conquered himself, and whose desires have vanished, reaches that stage of perfect freedom through his renunciation, where action completes itself and leaves no seed.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे। समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा।।
transliteration_iast: siddhiṁ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣhṭhā jñānasya yā parā
english_translation: I will now state briefly how one who has reached perfection finds the Eternal Spirit, the state of Supreme Wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च। शब्दादीन् विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च।।
transliteration_iast: buddhyā viśhuddhayā yukto dhṛityātmānaṁ niyamya cha śhabdādīn viṣhayāns tyaktvā rāga-dveṣhau vyudasya cha
english_translation: Guided always by pure reason, bravely restraining himself, renouncing the objects of sense and giving up attachment and hatred; he attains peace.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः। ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः।।
transliteration_iast: vivikta-sevī laghv-āśhī yata-vāk-kāya-mānasaḥ dhyāna-yoga-paro nityaṁ vairāgyaṁ samupāśhritaḥ
english_translation: Enjoying solitude, being abstemious, having his body, mind, and speech under perfect control, and being absorbed in meditation, he becomes free—always filled with the spirit of renunciation.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम्। विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।
transliteration_iast: ahankāraṁ balaṁ darpaṁ kāmaṁ krodhaṁ parigraham vimuchya nirmamaḥ śhānto brahma-bhūyāya kalpate
english_translation: Having abandoned selfishness, power, arrogance, anger, and desire, possessing nothing of his own, and having attained peace, he is fit to join the Eternal Spirit.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति। समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्।।
transliteration_iast: brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śhochati na kāṅkṣhati samaḥ sarveṣhu bhūteṣhu mad-bhaktiṁ labhate parām
english_translation: When he unites with the Eternal and his soul knows the bliss of the Self, he feels no desire or regret, he regards all beings equally, and enjoys the blessing of supreme devotion to Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः। ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्।।
transliteration_iast: bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaśh chāsmi tattvataḥ tato māṁ tattvato jñātvā viśhate tad-anantaram
english_translation: By such devotion, he sees Me, who I am and what I am; and thus realizing the truth, he enters into My kingdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः। मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-karmāṇy api sadā kurvāṇo mad-vyapāśhrayaḥ mat-prasādād avāpnoti śhāśhvataṁ padam avyayam
english_translation: Relying on Me in all his actions and doing them for My sake, he attains, by My grace, eternal and unchangeable life.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः। बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव।।
transliteration_iast: chetasā sarva-karmāṇi mayi sannyasya mat-paraḥ buddhi-yogam upāśhritya mach-chittaḥ satataṁ bhava
english_translation: Surrender your actions to Me, live in Me, focus your intellect on Me, and always think of Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि। अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि।।
transliteration_iast: mach-chittaḥ sarva-durgāṇi mat-prasādāt tariṣhyasi atha chet tvam ahankārān na śhroṣhyasi vinaṅkṣhyasi
english_translation: Fix your mind on Me, and by My grace you will overcome the obstacles in your path. But if, misled by pride, you do not listen, then you will indeed be lost.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे। मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति।।
transliteration_iast: yad ahankāram āśhritya na yotsya iti manyase mithyaiṣha vyavasāyas te prakṛitis tvāṁ niyokṣhyati
english_translation: If you in your vanity think of avoiding this fight, your will shall not be fulfilled, for Nature herself will compel you.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा। कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्।।
transliteration_iast: swbhāva-jena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā kartuṁ nechchhasi yan mohāt kariṣhyasy avaśho ’pi tat
english_translation: O Arjuna! Your duty binds you. It has arisen from your own nature, and that which you do not desire to do in your delusion, you will do that very thing. You are helpless.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति। भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया।।
transliteration_iast: īśhvaraḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ hṛid-deśhe ‘rjuna tiṣhṭhati bhrāmayan sarva-bhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
english_translation: God dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna! He causes them to revolve, as it were, on a wheel, by His mystic power.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत। तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्।।
transliteration_iast: tam eva śharaṇaṁ gachchha sarva-bhāvena bhārata tat-prasādāt parāṁ śhāntiṁ sthānaṁ prāpsyasi śhāśhvatam
english_translation: With all your strength, fly to Him and surrender yourself, and by His grace you will attain Supreme Peace and reach the Eternal Home.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया। विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु।।
transliteration_iast: iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā vimṛiśhyaitad aśheṣheṇa yathechchhasi tathā kuru
english_translation: Thus, I have revealed to you the truth, the mystery of mysteries. Having thought it over, you are free to act as you wish.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः श्रृणु मे परमं वचः। इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-guhyatamaṁ bhūyaḥ śhṛiṇu me paramaṁ vachaḥ iṣhṭo ‘si me dṛiḍham iti tato vakṣhyāmi te hitam
english_translation: Listen to My last word once more, the deepest secret of all; you are My beloved, you are My friend, and I speak for your welfare.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु। मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे।।
transliteration_iast: man-manā bhava mad-bhakto mad-yājī māṁ namaskuru mām evaiṣhyasi satyaṁ te pratijāne priyo ‘si me
english_translation: Dedicate yourself to Me, worship Me, sacrifice all for Me, prostrate yourself before Me, and you will surely come to Me. I truly pledge to you; you are My beloved.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज। अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः।।
transliteration_iast: sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śharaṇaṁ vraja ahaṁ tvāṁ sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣhayiṣhyāmi mā śhuchaḥ
english_translation: Give up your earthly duties, surrender yourself to Me alone. Do not be anxious; I will absolve you from all your sins.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन। न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति।।
transliteration_iast: idaṁ te nātapaskyāya nābhaktāya kadāchana na chāśhuśhruṣhave vāchyaṁ na cha māṁ yo ‘bhyasūtayi
english_translation: Do not speak this to one who has not practiced austerities, or to one who does not love, or who will not listen, or who mocks.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति। भक्ितं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः।।
transliteration_iast: ya idaṁ paramaṁ guhyaṁ mad-bhakteṣhv abhidhāsyati bhaktiṁ mayi parāṁ kṛitvā mām evaiṣhyaty asanśhayaḥ
english_translation: But he who teaches this great secret to My devotees, his is the highest devotion, and he shall surely come to Me.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्िचन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः। भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि।।
transliteration_iast: na cha tasmān manuṣhyeṣhu kaśhchin me priya-kṛittamaḥ bhavitā na cha me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
english_translation: There is no one among men who can perform a service dearer to Me than this, nor is there any man on earth more beloved by Me than him.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः। ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः।।
transliteration_iast: adhyeṣhyate cha ya imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṁvādam āvayoḥ jñāna-yajñena tenāham iṣhṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ
english_translation: He who will study this spiritual discourse of ours, I assure you, they shall thereby worship Me at the altar of Wisdom.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च श्रृणुयादपि यो नरः। सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।
transliteration_iast: śhraddhāvān anasūyaśh cha śhṛiṇuyād api yo naraḥ so ‘pi muktaḥ śhubhāl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇya-karmaṇām
english_translation: Yes, he who listens to it with faith and without doubt, even he, freed from evil, will rise to the worlds which the virtuous attain through righteous deeds.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा। कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनञ्जय।।
transliteration_iast: kachchid etach chhrutaṁ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa chetasā kachchid ajñāna-sammohaḥ pranaṣhṭas te dhanañjaya
english_translation: O Arjuna, have you listened attentively to My words? Has your ignorance and delusion gone?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अर्जुन उवाच नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत। स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव।।
transliteration_iast: arjuna uvācha naṣhṭo mohaḥ smṛitir labdhā tvat-prasādān mayāchyuta sthito ‘smi gata-sandehaḥ kariṣhye vachanaṁ tava
english_translation: Arjuna replied: "My Lord! O Immutable One! My delusion has fled. By Your Grace, O Changeless One, the light has dawned. My doubts have been dispelled, and I stand before You ready to do Your will."
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: सञ्जय उवाच इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः। संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्।।
transliteration_iast: sañjaya uvācha ity ahaṁ vāsudevasya pārthasya cha mahātmanaḥ saṁvādam imam aśhrauṣham adbhutaṁ roma-harṣhaṇam
english_translation: Sanjaya said: "I heard this rare, wonderful, and soul-stirring discourse between Lord Shri Krishna and the great-souled Arjuna.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम्। योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्।।
transliteration_iast: vyāsa-prasādāch chhrutavān etad guhyam ahaṁ param yogaṁ yogeśhvarāt kṛiṣhṇāt sākṣhāt kathayataḥ svayam
english_translation: Through the blessing of the sage Vyasa, I heard this secret and noble science from the lips of its Master, Lord Shri Krishna.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम्। केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः।।
transliteration_iast: rājan sansmṛitya sansmṛitya saṁvādam imam adbhutam keśhavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṁ hṛiṣhyāmi cha muhur muhuḥ
english_translation: O King! The more I think of that marvelous and holy discourse, the more I lose myself in joy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः। विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः।।
transliteration_iast: tach cha sansmṛitya saṁsmṛitya rūpam aty-adbhutaṁ hareḥ vismayo ye mahān rājan hṛiṣhyāmi cha punaḥ punaḥ
