english_translation: As I recall again and again the exceeding beauty of the Lord, I am filled with amazement and joy.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम।।
transliteration_iast: yatra yogeśhvaraḥ kṛiṣhṇo yatra pārtho dhanur-dharaḥ tatra śhrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama
english_translation: Wherever Lord Shri Krishna, the Prince of Wisdom, and Arjuna, the Great Archer, are, I am certain that good fortune, victory, happiness, and righteousness will follow.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite Sanskrit + gita/gita Purohit English
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (CLTK/Gita Supersite). English: Unlicense packaging of Purohit.

sanskrit_devanagari: अथ योगानुशासनम्
english_translation: OM: Here follows Instruction in Union.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: योगश्चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधः
english_translation: Union, spiritual consciousness, is gained through control of the versatile psychic nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तदा द्रष्टुः स्वरूपेऽवस्थानम्
english_translation: Then the Seer comes to consciousness in his proper nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: वृत्तिसारूप्यमितरत्र
english_translation: Heretofore the Seer has been enmeshed in the activities of the psychic nature.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: वृत्तयः पञ्चतय्यः क्लिष्टाक्लिष्टाः
english_translation: The psychic activities are five; they are either subject or not subject to the five hindrances (Book II, 3).

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रमाणविपर्य्यविकल्पनिद्रास्मृतयः
english_translation: These activities are: Sound intellection, unsound intellection, predication, sleep, memory.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रत्यक्षानुमानागमाः प्रमाणानि
english_translation: The elements of sound intellection are: direct observation, inductive reason, and trustworthy testimony.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: विपर्ययो मिथ्याज्ञानमतद्रूपप्रतिष्ठम्
english_translation: Unsound intellection is false understanding, not resting on a perception of the true nature of things.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: शब्दज्ञानानुपाती वस्तुशून्यो विकल्पः
english_translation: Predication is carried on through words or thoughts not resting on an object perceived.

sanskrit_devanagari: अभावप्रत्ययालम्बना वृत्तिर्निद्रा
english_translation: Sleep is the psychic condition which rests on mind states, all material things being absent.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: अनुभूतविषयासंप्रमोषः स्मृतिः
english_translation: Memory is holding to mind-images of things perceived, without modifying them.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: अभ्यासवैराग्याभ्यां तन्निरोधः
english_translation: The control of these psychic activities comes through the right use of the will, and through ceasing from self-indulgence.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्र स्थितौ यत्नोऽभ्यासः
english_translation: The right use of the will is the steady, effort to stand in spiritual being.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: स तु दीर्घकालनैरंन्तर्यसत्कारासेवितो दृढ़भूमिः
english_translation: This becomes a firm resting-place, when followed long, persistently, with earnestness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: दृष्टानुश्रविकविषयवितृष्णस्य वशीकारसंज्ञा वैराग्यम्
english_translation: Ceasing from self-indulgence is conscious mastery over the thirst for sensuous pleasure here or hereafter.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्परं पुरुषख्यातेर्गुणवैतृष्ण्यम्
english_translation: The consummation of this is freedom from thirst for any mode of psychical activity, through the establishment of the spiritual man.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: वितर्कविचारानन्दास्मितारूपानुगमात्संप्रज्ञातः
english_translation: Meditation with an object follows these stages: first, exterior examining, then interior judicial action, then joy, then realization of individual being.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: विरामप्रत्ययाभ्यासपूर्वः संस्कारशेषोऽन्यः
english_translation: After the exercise of the will has stilled the psychic activities, meditation rests only on the fruit of former meditations.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: भवप्रत्ययो विदेहप्रकृतिलयानाम्
english_translation: Subjective consciousness arising from a natural cause is possessed by those who have laid aside their bodies and been absorbed into subjective nature.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: श्रद्धावीर्यस्मृतिसमाधिप्रज्ञापूर्वक इतरेषाम्
english_translation: For the others, there is spiritual consciousness, led up to by faith, valour, right mindfulness, one-pointedness, perception.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तीव्रसंवेगानामासन्नः
english_translation: Spiritual consciousness is nearest to those of keen, intense will.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: मृदुमध्याधिमात्रत्वात्ततोऽपि विशेषः
english_translation: The will may be weak, or of middle strength, or intense.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: ईश्वरप्रणिधानाद्वा
english_translation: Or spiritual consciousness may be gained by ardent service of the Master.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: क्लेशकर्मविपाकाशयैरपरामृष्टः पुरुषविशेष ईश्वरः
english_translation: The Master is the spiritual man, who is free from hindrances, bondage to works, and the fruition and seed of works.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्र निरतिशयं सर्वज्ञबीजम्
english_translation: In the Master is the perfect seed of Omniscience.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: स एषः पूर्वेषामपि गुरुः कालेनानवच्छेदात्
english_translation: He is the Teacher of all who have gone before, since he is not limited by Time.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तस्य वाचकः प्रणवः
english_translation: His word is OM.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तज्जपस्तदर्थभावनम्
english_translation: Let there be soundless repetition of OM and meditation thereon.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: ततः प्रत्यक्चेतनाधिगमोऽप्यन्तरायाभावश्च
english_translation: Thence come the awakening of interior consciousness, and the removal of barriers.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: व्याधिस्त्यानसंशयमप्रमादालस्याविरतिभ्रान्तिदर्शनालब्धभूमिकत्वानवस्थितत्वानि चित्तविक्षेपास्तेऽन्तरायाः
english_translation: The barriers to interior consciousness, which drive the psychic nature this way and that, are these: sickness, inertia, doubt, lightmindedness, laziness, intemperance, false notions, inability to reach a stage of meditation, or to hold it when reached.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: दुःखदौर्मनस्याङ्गमेजयत्वश्वासप्रश्वासा विक्षेपसहभुवः
english_translation: Grieving, despondency, bodily restlessness, the drawing in and sending forth of the life-breath also contribute to drive the psychic nature to and fro.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्प्रतिषेधार्थमेकतत्त्वाभ्यासः
english_translation: Steady application to a principle is the way to put a stop to these.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: मैत्रीकरुणामुदितोपेक्षाणां सुखदुःखपुण्यापुण्यविषयाणां भावनातश्चित्तप्रसादनम्
english_translation: By sympathy with the happy, compassion for the sorrowful, delight in the holy, disregard of the unholy, the psychic nature moves to gracious peace.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रच्छर्दनविधारणाभ्यां वा प्राणस्य
english_translation: Or peace may be reached by the even sending forth and control of the life-breath.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: विषयवती वा प्रवृत्तिरुत्पन्ना मनसः स्थितिनिबन्धनी
english_translation: Faithful, persistent application to any object, if completely attained, will bind the mind to steadiness.

sanskrit_devanagari: विशोका वा ज्योतिष्मति
english_translation: As also will a joyful, radiant spirit.

sanskrit_devanagari: वीतरागविषयं वा चित्तम्
english_translation: Or the purging of self-indulgence from the psychic nature.

sanskrit_devanagari: स्वप्ननिद्राज्ञानालम्बनं वा
english_translation: Or a pondering on the perceptions gained in dreams and dreamless sleep.

sanskrit_devanagari: यथाभिमतध्यानाद्वा
english_translation: Or meditative brooding on what is dearest to the heart.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: परमाणुपरममहत्त्वान्तोऽस्य वशीकारः
english_translation: Thus he masters all, from the atom to the Infinite.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)

sanskrit_devanagari: स्थान्युपनिमन्त्रणे सङ्गस्मयाकरणं पुनरनिष्टप्रसङ्गात्
english_translation: There should be complete overcoming of allurement or pride in the invitations of the different realms of life, lest attachment to things evil arise once more.

sanskrit_devanagari: क्षणतत्क्रमयोः संयमाद्विवेकजं ज्ञानम्
english_translation: From perfectly concentrated Meditation on the divisions of time and their succession comes that wisdom which is born of discernment.

sanskrit_devanagari: जातिलक्षणदेशैरन्यतानवच्छेदात्तुल्ययोस्ततः प्रतिपत्तिः
english_translation: Hence comes discernment between things which are of like nature, not distinguished by difference of kind, character or position.

sanskrit_devanagari: तारकं सर्वविषयं सर्वथाविषयमक्रमं चेति विवेकजं ज्ञानम्
english_translation: The wisdom which is born of discernment is starlike; it discerns all things, and all conditions of things, it discerns without succession: simultaneously.

sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वपुरुषयोः शुद्धिसाम्ये कैवल्यमिति
english_translation: When the vesture and the spiritual man are alike pure, then perfect spiritual life is attained.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: जन्मौषधिमन्त्रतपः समाधिजाः सिद्धयः
english_translation: Psychic and spiritual powers may be inborn, or they may be gained by the use of drugs, or by incantations, or by fervour, or by Meditation.

sanskrit_devanagari: जात्यन्तरपरिणामः प्रकृत्यापूरात्
english_translation: The transfer of powers from one venture to another comes through the flow of the natural creative forces.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: निमित्तमप्रयोजकं प्रकृतीनां वरणभेदस्तु ततः क्षेत्रिकवत्
english_translation: The apparent, immediate cause is not the true cause of the creative nature-powers; but, like the husbandman in his field, it takes obstacles away.

sanskrit_devanagari: निर्माणचित्तान्यस्मितामात्रात्
english_translation: Vestures of consciousness are built up in conformity with the Boston of the feeling of selfhood.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रवृत्तिभेदे प्रयोजकं चित्तमेकमनेकेषाम्
english_translation: In the different fields of manifestation, the Consciousness, though one, is the elective cause of many states of consciousness.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तत्र ध्यानजमनाशयम्
english_translation: Among states of consciousness, that which is born of Contemplation is free from the seed of future sorrow.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: कर्माशुक्लाकृष्णं योगिनस्त्रिविधमितरेषाम्
english_translation: The works of followers after Union make neither for bright pleasure nor for dark pain The works of others make for pleasure or pain, or a mingling of these.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: ततस्तद्विपाकानुगुणानामेवाभिव्यक्तिर्वासनानाम्
english_translation: From the force inherent in works comes the manifestation of those dynamic mind images which are conformable to the ripening out of each of these works.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: जातिदेशकालव्यवहितानामप्यानन्तर्यं स्मृतिसंस्कारयोरेकरूपत्वात्
english_translation: Works separated by different nature, or place, or time, are brought together by the correspondence between memory and dynamic impression.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तासामनादित्वं चाऽऽशिषो नित्यत्वात्
english_translation: The series of dynamic mind-images is beginningless, because Desire is everlasting.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: हेतुफलाश्रयालम्बनैः संगृहीतत्वादेषामभावे तदभावः
english_translation: Since the dynamic mind-images are held together by impulses of desire, by the wish for personal reward, by the substratum of mental habit, by the support of outer things desired; therefore, when these cease, the self reproduction of dynamic mind-images ceases.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: अतीतानागतं स्वरूपतोऽस्त्यध्वभेदाद्धर्माणाम्
english_translation: The difference between that which is past and that which is not yet come, according to their natures, depends on the difference of phase of their properties.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: ते व्यक्तसूक्ष्मा गुणात्मानः
english_translation: These properties, whether manifest or latent, are of the nature of the Three Potencies.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: परिणामैकत्वाद्वस्तुतत्त्वम्
english_translation: The external manifestation of an object takes place when the transformations ore in the same phase.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: वस्तुसाम्ये चित्तभेदात्तयोर्विभक्तः पन्थाः
english_translation: The paths of material things and of states of consciousness are distinct, as is manifest from the fact that the same object may produce different impressions in different minds.
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: न चैकचित्ततन्त्रं वस्तु तदप्रमाणकं तदा किं स्यात्
english_translation: Nor do material objects depend upon a single mind, for how could they remain objective to others, if that mind ceased to think of them?
source: CLTK Gita Supersite sutra.txt + Project Gutenberg 2526 (Johnston 1912)
license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तदुपरागापेक्षित्वाच्चित्तस्य वस्तु ज्ञाता ज्ञातम्
english_translation: An object is perceived, or not perceived, according as the mind is, or is not, tinged with the colour of the object.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: सदाज्ञाताश्चित्तवृत्तयस्तत्प्रभोः पुरुषस्यापरिणामित्वात्
english_translation: The movements of the psychic nature are perpetually objects of perception, since the Spiritual Man, who is the lord of them, remains unchanging.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: न तत्स्वाभासं दृश्यत्वात्
english_translation: The Mind is not self-luminous, since it can be seen as an object.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: एकसमये चोभयानवधारणम्
english_translation: Nor could the Mind at the same time know itself and things external to it.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: चित्तान्तरदृश्ये बुद्धिबुद्धेरतिप्रसङ्गः स्मृतिसंकरश्च
english_translation: If the Mind be thought of as seen by another more inward Mind, then there would be an endless series of perceiving Minds, and a confusion of memories.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: चित्तेरप्रतिसंक्रमायास्तदाकारापत्तौ स्वबुद्धिसंवेदनम्
english_translation: When the psychical nature takes on the form of the spiritual intelligence, by reflecting it, then the Self becomes conscious of its own spiritual intelligence.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: द्रष्टृदृश्योपरक्तं चित्तं सर्वार्थम्
english_translation: The psychic nature, taking on the colour of the Seer and of things seen, leads to the perception of all objects.

sanskrit_devanagari: तदसंख्येयवासनाभिश्चित्रमपि परार्थं संहत्यकारित्वात्
english_translation: The psychic nature, which has been printed with mind-images of innumerable material things, exists now for the Spiritual Man, building for him.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: विशेषदर्शिन आत्मभावभावनानिवृत्तिः
english_translation: For him who discerns between the Mind and the Spiritual Man, there comes perfect fruition of the longing after the real being of the Self.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तदा विवेकनिम्नं कैवल्यप्राग्भारं चित्तम्
english_translation: Thereafter, the whole personal being bends toward illumination, toward Eternal Life.

sanskrit_devanagari: तच्छिद्रेषु प्रत्ययान्तराणि संस्कारेभ्यः
english_translation: In the internals of the batik, other thoughts will arise, through the impressions of the dynamic mind-images.

sanskrit_devanagari: हानमेषां क्लेशवदुक्तम्
english_translation: These are to be overcome as it was taught that hindrances should be overcome.

sanskrit_devanagari: प्रसंख्यानेऽप्यकुसीदस्य सर्वथा विवेकख्यातेर्धर्ममेघः समाधिः
english_translation: He who, after he has attained, is wholly free from self, reaches the essence of all that can be known, gathered together like a cloud.

sanskrit_devanagari: ततः क्लेशकर्मनिवृत्तिः
english_translation: Thereon comes surcease from sorrow and the burden of toil.

license: Sanskrit: Public Domain Mark 1.0. English: public domain (Johnston 1912 / Gutenberg 2526).

sanskrit_devanagari: तदा सर्वावरणमलापेतस्य ज्ञानस्याऽऽनन्त्याज्ज्ञेयमल्पम्
english_translation: When all veils are rent, all stains washed away, his knowledge becomes infinite; little remains for him to know.

sanskrit_devanagari: ततः कृतार्थानां परिणामक्रमसमाप्तिर्गुणानाम्
english_translation: Thereafter comes the completion of the series of transformations of the three nature potencies, since their purpose is attained.

sanskrit_devanagari: क्षणप्रतियोगी परिणामापरान्तनिर्ग्राह्यः क्रमः
english_translation: The series of transformations is divided into moments.

sanskrit_devanagari: पुरुषार्थशून्यानां गुणानां प्रतिप्रसवः कैवल्यं स्वरूपप्रतिष्ठा वा चितिशक्तिरिति
english_translation: Pure spiritual life is, therefore, the inverse resolution of the potencies of Nature, which have emptied themselves of their value for the Spiritual man; or it is the return of the power of pure Consciousness to its essential form.
